jobs.title: GTM Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Lantern** Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com. Lantern is seeking a GTM Solutions Engineer — a forward\-deployed technical specialist embedded within the Growth Marketing function and serving as the primary systems owner for the entire Growth Marketing tech stack. This role owns the how: architecting integrations, deploying AI\-powered and agentic automation, and ensuring Lantern's marketing technology stack is scalable, measurable, and continuously improving. The ideal candidate is a lead management expert who operates with a high degree of autonomy, brings hands\-on AI maturity, and understands the Growth Marketing function as deeply as the tools that support it. They know when to apply AI and when traditional integrated solutions are the right answer \- and can defend that judgment to leadership with data and conviction. **Location:** Hybrid \- at least 3 days/week in our New York City office **Your Mission** Reporting to the Sr. Director, GTM Systems and embedded within Growth Marketing, you will: * Act as an embedded technical owner for the Growth Marketing tech stack \- partnering directly with Growth Marketing leadership to translate business needs into working solutions, leading every stage from requirements gathering and solution design through build, testing, and deployment with a high degree of autonomy. * Own, operate, and continuously improve the full Growth Marketing tech stack: HubSpot, Outreach, Nooks, ZoomInfo, Clay, and Salesforce – identify gaps and help shape where the stack goes from here. * Design and implement lead management workflows end\-to\-end: from initial intake and campaign execution through outbound engagement and conversion tracking, ensuring every handoff is instrumented and every outcome is measurable. * Build and deploy agentic and AI\-powered solutions that eliminate manual process across top\-of\-funnel workflows \- knowing when AI is the right answer and when a traditional integration is faster and more reliable. * Pilot new tools with rigor: develop a structured point of view on trade\-offs and ROI, document your findings, and present clear build\-vs.\-buy recommendations to leadership. * Maintain a prioritized, visible systems roadmap \- communicating what is in progress, what is next, and why, in a format that earns the trust of non\-technical stakeholders. * Articulate system and workflow designs in Lucid or comparable diagramming tools, and explain those designs to non\-technical marketing leaders in a way that is compelling and builds confidence. * Collaborate with the Salesforce Admin team and Salesforce Architect on CRM\-side implementations \- and bring hands\-on Salesforce Flows experience (and Apex/SQL where needed) to accelerate delivery without waiting on others. * Be relentlessly organized: plan, test, and measure every solution with documented baselines and outcomes \- so the team always knows what changed and whether it worked. **What You Will Bring** * A minimum of 5 years owning or deeply administering a B2B growth marketing tech stack (CRM, sales engagement, data enrichment, \& marketing automation tools). * Hands\-on production experience with Clay. * Demonstrated, shipped AI and agentic automation experience applied to GTM or revenue operations workflows \- with a clear, defensible point of view on when AI is and isn't the right answer. * Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously across the full project lifecycle. * First\-hand lead management experience \- supporting lead intake, campaigns, outbound sales engagement, and tracking leads through to conversion. * Proven ability to instrument lead tracking end\-to\-end and surface actionable conversion analytics to team managers \- with an understanding of what it takes to build and sustain lead data quality across integrated systems. * Ability to translate business requirements into measurable technical outcomes \- and communicate system designs clearly and compellingly to non\-technical marketing leadership. * Proven ability to pilot new jobs.title: Computer Network Engineer
jobs.description: Local Managed Services Provider, is looking for an experienced **Level II/III Network \& Systems Engineer** to support our business clients throughout the Greater Sacramento area. **This is not an entry\-level position.** We are specifically looking for someone who has **real\-world, hands\-on troubleshooting experience** — not simply familiarity with the technologies listed below. The right person should be comfortable receiving a support issue, asking the right questions, troubleshooting it methodically, and taking ownership of the problem through resolution. What You'll Be Doing You will support and maintain IT environments for multiple business clients, including: * Windows desktops and laptops * Windows Server environments * Active Directory and Group Policy * Microsoft 365 administration * Exchange Online * OneDrive and SharePoint * DNS, DHCP and TCP/IP networking * Firewalls, switches, routers and wireless networks * VPN and remote\-access troubleshooting * Printers, scanners and other business peripherals * Hardware installation, diagnosis and replacement * Software and application troubleshooting * User account, permission and security administration * Remote and onsite client support Because we are an MSP, you will work with **multiple client environments and different configurations**. You must be able to adapt, investigate and troubleshoot rather than expect every environment to be identical. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone with at least **2\+ years of meaningful hands\-on IT support and systems/network administration experience**, preferably in an MSP or multi\-client environment. You should be able to independently troubleshoot issues such as: * A user suddenly cannot access a network resource * A workstation cannot communicate with a server or network device * DNS, DHCP or connectivity problems * Microsoft 365 authentication, email or account issues * Active Directory account, computer and permission problems * VPN and remote connectivity issues * Printer/scanner connectivity and network configuration * Server services that have stopped functioning properly * Problems where the answer isn't immediately obvious We don't expect anyone to know everything. **We do expect you to know how to troubleshoot.** You should be comfortable researching an unfamiliar issue, determining the likely cause, testing your solution and knowing when an issue needs to be escalated. Technical Experience Strong working knowledge of: * Microsoft Windows 10/11 * Windows Server * Active Directory * Group Policy * Microsoft 365 administration * Exchange Online * TCP/IP networking * DNS and DHCP * Firewalls, routers, switches and VPNs * Network troubleshooting * PC hardware and peripherals Experience with additional business applications, backup systems, virtualization, cybersecurity products, VoIP or cloud platforms is a plus. Just as Important as Technical Skills Our clients depend on us, so technical knowledge alone isn't enough. We're looking for someone who: * Communicates professionally with clients * Can explain technical issues in understandable terms * Takes ownership of problems * Documents their work * Is dependable and organized * Knows when to ask for assistance * Can work independently without needing constant direction * Works well as part of a small, experienced technical team * Is comfortable moving between different client environments throughout the day Location \& Transportation This position combines **work\-from\-home remote support with onsite client support**. You **must live in the Sacramento area or nearby** and be available to travel to client locations when onsite assistance is required. Candidates must have: * Valid California driver's license * Proof of automobile insurance * Reliable vehicle What We Offer * Full\-time position * Employer\-paid medical benefits * Paid vacation * Work\-from\-home flexibility when providing remote support * Variety of technical environments and projects * Experienced team environment * A company that believes strongly in maintaining a reasonable balance between work and personal life Our Hiring Process Because hands\-on troubleshooting ability is important for this position, qualified candidates should expect a **practical technical evaluation as part of the interview process**. This isn't a trivia test. We want to understand **how you approach and troubleshoot real IT problems.** If you have genuine Level II/III technical experience, enjoy solving problems, work well with clients and want to be part of a local MSP team, we'd like to hear from you. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off Education: * High school or equivalent (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Folsom, CA

partner with operational teams on implementation, integration and lifecycle management. * Support material AI security incidents and convert lessons learned into improved controls, standards and engineering guidance. * Occasional domestic and international travel (approx. 5%) for meetings and collaboration. **Basic Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, software engineering, mathematics, or a related field * 8\+ years in product security, application security, cloud security, security engineering or a closely related discipline**.** **Preferred Qualifications:** * Demonstrated track record of delivering complex security initiatives from assessment and design through implementation, validation and operational handover, with measurable adoption and risk\-reduction outcomes. * Experience leading security architecture reviews, threat modelling and remediation through the software or product development lifecycle. * Strong understanding of AI security threats and mitigations. * Experience designing or assessing security controls across cloud environments, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, identity/access management and data flows. * Ability to convert security findings and standards into prioritized technical requirements, clear delivery plans and implementable remediation guidance for engineering teams. * Ability to participate in incident response and product security operations as required. * Relevant security certifications are advantageous. Location: US \- Morrisville preferred; remote\-based within the U.S. may be considered. In compliance with Colorado's EPEWA, the expected application deadline for this position is October 25, 2026\. jobs.title: Sr Consulting/Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Are you passionate about building secure, scalable technology solutions and leading innovation across AI, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure? Do you enjoy mentoring engineers, shaping technical standards, and solving complex business challenges through modern engineering practices? **About the Business** LexisNexis® Risk Solutions provides customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. We use the power of data and advanced analytics to help our customers make better, timelier decisions. By bringing clarity to information, we ultimately help make communities safer, insurance rates more accurate, commerce more transparent, business decisions easier and processes more efficient. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/ **About our Team** ACE (AI \& Core Engineering) is a shared services technology organization within LexisNexis Risk Solutions focused on building the foundational engineering platforms, cloud capabilities, and applied AI solutions that power the company’s risk, identity, fraud, and data\-driven products. The team combines core software engineering, cloud architecture, and AI/ML enablement to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable capabilities used across product lines, helping teams move faster while maintaining enterprise\-grade quality, governance, and operational excellence. **About the Role:** This position is a subject matter expert on broad technologies and sets the architectural standard for the workgroup. The position executes corporate tactical technology strategy on large multifunctional development activities, solves complex technical problems, writes complex code for computer systems, and serves as a senior source of expertise. This position is expected to be seen as a “go to” person across the division for a set of technologies. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** **CORE ENGINEERING SKILLS:** * Industrywide or broad companywide technical knowledge across large, complex systems. * Expertise in development languages; proficient in reading, writing, reviewing, and generating code across most modern languages. * Software development process expert in applicable methodologies, practices, and emerging trends. * Strong knowledge of architectural principles and proven application of industry best practices across all aspects of development. * Expertise in test\-driven development, automated testing, and maintenance techniques applied for overall project benefit. * Expertise in data modeling (normalized/dimensional), data manipulation languages, optimization, tuning, and best practices. * Expert knowledge of multiple data storage subsystems and complex data models. * Knowledge of domain specific languages and their application. * Ability to write and review detailed specifications for system components of advanced complexity. **AI SOFTWARE ENGINEERING SKILLS:** * Ability to spot AI hallucination in results and apply techniques to remove them * Specialized coding skills with an emphasis on high\-quality, review\-ready AI code generation and human\-in\-the\-loop validation. * Ability to prompt and orchestrate all forms of AI\-assisted work tools, including enterprise tools such as M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Cowork, Enterprise ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and other modern AI harnesses. * Ability to write effective markdown, instructions, and agent/skill definitions to support prompting, MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration, workflow automation, code generation, and spec\-driven development. * Experience with spec\-driven and context\-driven development: authoring requirements, specs, and evals that AI agents can execute reliably. * Ability to design, build, and integrate AI agents and multi\-agent workflows, including tool/function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and MCP servers/clients. * Understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, context management, embeddings/vector stores, evaluation, guardrails, and cost/latency/token optimization. * Ability to evaluate AI\-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability, and to establish team standards for responsible, secure AI\-assisted SDLC practices. * Awareness of AI safety, data governance, and privacy considerations (e.g., PII handling, model/data provenance) in AI\-assisted engineering workflows. **SECURITY SKILLS:** * Security expert across domains, security champion. * Cloud and infrastructure security fundamentals: identity and access management, secrets management, network segmentation, and least\-privilege design. * Deep understanding of direct and indirect prompt injection, model poisoning, confused deputy, and other emerging AI threats. * Understanding of the principles in OWASP, NIST, ISO, and other international security standards. * Ability to spot insecure code and remediate it qu earch — strong ability to rapidly read, comprehend, and synthesize documentation, code, specs, and research to inform sound technical decisions. * Writing — clear, concise, and effective written communication, including specifications, documentation, and AI prompts/instructions. * Verbal communication — articulate and precise in discussions with peers, stakeholders, and leadership. * Presentation — able to present complex technical information concisely and persuasively to audiences ranging from engineers to senior and executive management. * Small\-team efficiency — thrives in lean, high\-trust teams; self\-directed, collaborative, and able to deliver outsized impact with minimal overhead. * Advanced problem\-solving — identifies, researches, and coordinates the resources needed to diagnose complex issues, translate findings into solutions, and surface risks and trade\-offs for decision\-making. **ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Perform reviews to ensure enterprise and architectural standards and processes are followed. * Build smart and jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Description**We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance. At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in\-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in\-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects. **This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, and Boston, MA.** ***You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.*** **We will not sponsor employment visas.** *Candidates who will require future sponsorship, including candidates on CPT/OPT/STEMOPT who will require future sponsorship, are not eligible to apply.* **Job Introduction:** We are seeking a **Principal Full Stack Engineer** to join the Global Enterprise Services team within Global Finance Tech (GFT). In this role, you will serve as the technical leader for the Jet Setters squad, setting the technical direction for and driving the architecture, design, and delivery of back\-end and full\-stack applications. The Jet Setters squad owns a portfolio of 22 GFT products, including the Reservation System, Contracts Portal, Non\-Employee Portal, Corporate Aviation Flight Approvals and Business Impact Analysis (BIA). As the most senior engineer on the squad, you will partner with product owners, business partners, architects and engineering leadership to shape the long\-term technical roadmap and deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions including the strategic integration of AI\-powered capabilities that enhance user experiences and operational efficiency. You will act as a force multiplier: mentoring engineers, elevating engineering standards, and influencing technical decisions. **About the job:** * Set the technical vision and architecture strategy for the squad’s portfolio, balancing immediate delivery needs with long term scalability and maintainability. * Lead the design and development of complex, high impact applications and shared platform capabilities. * Drive architectural decisions and establish patterns, frameworks, and reusable components adopted across teams. * Provide technical leadership and hands\-on mentorship to engineers, fostering growth and raising the bar for engineering quality. * Establish and champion engineering guidelines, standards, and best practices across the organization. * Review code and technical designs, providing actionable feedback and ensuring adherence to architectural and quality standards. * Own and evolved automated testing, CI/CD, and observability strategies to ensure reliability and operational excellence. * Lead impact analyses and technical solutioning for the most complex, systemic, and high\-risk changes. * Develop and recommend technical alternatives for ambiguous, large scale, or systemic problems. * Guide production support strategy, including complex incident triage, root cause analysis, and defect resolution. * Author and steward architecture documentation, technical specifications, and production support artifacts. * Define and lead the strategy for integrating AI\-powered features and capabilities across existing and new product lines. * Partner with product and business leaders to translate business objectives into technical strategy and influence prioritization and roadmaps. * Collaborate with your team’s solutions engineer and architects on enterprise\-wide technical initiatives and governance. **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in technical or business discipline. * Minimum **8\+ years of Full Stack Engineering experience**, including demonstrated experience as a technical lead or principal engineer. * Deep expertise in applying object\-oriented design patterns, architectural patterns, and distributed systems principles. * Advanced proficiency with **TypeScript, React, Node.js, AWS Lambda, AWS S3, SQL, Spring Boot, GitHub Actions.** * Experience with GitHub Copilot or similar products such as Claude Code, including driving adoption of AI\-assisted development practices across teams. * Proven track record architecting, delivering, and supporting multiple complex, large scale production applications. * Expert knowledge of IT concepts, strategies, and methodologies, with the ability to set technical direction across teams. * Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams technically, mentoring engineers, and driving adoption of best practices. * Deep experience with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum) and scaling engineering practices. * Expertise designing and optimizing CI/CD pipelines and tooling, and defining testing frameworks, strategies, and best practices. * Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across engineering, product, and business partners. * Exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills, with strong ownership and initiative. * Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Team\-oriented leader, with strong collaboration, prioritization, and adaptability skills. **Nice to Have Qualifications: AI \& Emerging Technologies** * Understanding of AI/ML concepts and how they apply to software product development at scale. * Experience architecting and integrating Large Language Model (LLM) APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) into production applications. * Hands\-on experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, including vector databases and embedding models. * Experience designing solutions with AI orchestration frameworks. * Expertise in prompt engineering techniques and best practices for building reliable, production\-grade AI\-driven features. * Understanding of responsible AI principles, including bias awareness, explainability, and data privacy considerations. * Experience designing, building, or consuming AI\-powered APIs and microservices in a cloud\-native environment (AWS preferred). **About Us****Pay Philosophy:** The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role. At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well\-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://LMI.co/Benefits Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. **Fair Chance Notices** * California * Los Angeles Incorporated * Los Angeles Unincorporated * Philadelphia * San Francisco

jobs.title: HR Operations Specialist
jobs.description: At Lightspeed Systems, we're on a mission to help schools create safer, more effective digital learning environments. Trusted by thousands of schools worldwide, our solutions help education leaders manage technology, protect students, and improve learning outcomes. We need an HR Operations Specialist who loves building clean, reliable systems and processes that scale with us. This is a builder's role. You'll take full ownership of our HR systems, records, and workflows: standardizing them, strengthening them, and continuously improving how they run. You'll make sure the data, the paperwork, the process, and the system of record are accurate, current, and built to scale. You'll be part systems owner, part process architect, part detail\-obsessed operator, and 100% focused on giving Lightspeed an HR foundation that holds up. **NOTE:** This position is hybrid and requires several days on site each week at our Austin, TX headquarters. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * **Own HR systems and data integrity.** Administer our HRIS and ATS end\-to\-end, and make sure our systems of record stay accurate, consistent, and fully trustworthy. * **Administer the employee lifecycle.** Process new hire paperwork, coordinate onboarding logistics (accounts, equipment requests, orientation scheduling), manage offboarding checklists and documentation, and maintain personnel files. * **Own compliance recordkeeping.** Manage I\-9/E\-Verify processes, required labor law postings, policy acknowledgment tracking, personnel file audits, and support EEO/ACA reporting. * **Administer benefits and leave logistics.** Process enrollments and life\-event changes, reconcile vendor invoices, and track leave documentation (FMLA, state leave, accommodations paperwork). * **Build and document HR processes.** Create clear, documented SOPs and repeatable workflows for onboarding, offboarding, leave, systems maintenance, and anywhere else a strong process makes the whole team faster. * **Support recruiting operations.** Post jobs, coordinate interview scheduling, generate offer letters, manage background checks, and keep the ATS pipeline clean and current. * **Produce HR reporting.** Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards (headcount, turnover, compliance status) for leadership. * **Use AI like it's part of your toolkit.** Use AI tools to draft communications, summarize data, build templates, and generally make the admin work faster and sharper. We're not asking you to be an engineer; we're asking you to be curious and current. **WHAT YOU BRING** * 3–5 years of experience in an HR administrative, HR operations, HRIS, or generalist role with heavy systems and process ownership, not just checklist execution. * A demonstrated track record of building and strengthening HR systems and processes independently. * Strong HRIS/ATS experience: comfortable configuring, auditing, and maintaining data integrity in HR systems. * Sharp attention to detail and a documentation\-first instinct: you naturally build the SOP and make processes repeatable rather than relying on memory alone. * Working knowledge of core HR compliance requirements (I\-9, FMLA/leave basics, recordkeeping). * Self\-starter energy and a fast, independent learning style. You don't need a training plan or a lot of handholding; you dig in, find the answer, and figure out the tool or process on your own before asking. * Comfort with HR technology and genuine curiosity about AI. You're not waiting for a workshop to figure out how tools like Claude/ChatGPT, Copilot, or other AI platforms can make you sharper. * Clear, precise written communication: you can write a policy, SOP, or process doc that people can understand and follow. **NICE\-TO\-HAVES** * Experience with HR system implementations, migrations, or large\-scale process improvements. * Edtech or SaaS background: if you already understand our world, you'll ramp faster and contribute sooner. * Familiarity with payroll processes and tools. * PHR or SHRM\-CP certification, preferred. **WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE** * Your work will directly support the people who protect millions of students in classrooms every day. The mission is real, and it shows up in how we work. * You'll get real ownership of the systems and processes that run HR here, with plenty of room to build them out and leave your fingerprints on how we operate. * You'll join a smart, driven, mission\-focused team that cares deeply about both impact and each other. **ABOUT US** With more than 25 years of serving education, Lightspeed Systems delivers the most in\-depth visibility and control to power exceptional schools where students are safe and engaged; technology is compliant and easily managed; and resources are secure and optimized. Purpose\-built for school networks and devices, Lightspeed's cloud\-managed solutions include the most effective web filtering, student safety monitoring, classroom management, device management, and data analytics software available. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with a European office in London, UK, Lightspeed serves over 23 million students across 31,000 schools in 43 countries, utilizing 15 million devices. Learn more at www.lightspeedsystems.com. We love our employees, and we show it. Our benefits and perks are built to support your overall wellbeing—at work and beyond. Offerings vary by country. **ABOUT OUR ATX HQ** If your role includes spending time onsite, you will LOVE being at the ranch. Our uniquely Lightspeed (and totally Texas) corporate headquarters has everything Lightspeeders need to get the job done – and a whole lot more. * 15,000 sq. ft. of open work area, offices, and huddle rooms * Snacks galore and a private chef serving up lunch Tuesday through Thursday every week * A state\-of\-the\-art fitness center (with outfitted locker rooms) * Physical therapist onsite regularly * Indoor and outdoor casual collaboration spots * Pet\-friendly office environment * A golf simulator, go\-carts, shuffleboard, corn hole, and MORE fun All within 31 sprawling acres of Live Oak trees that foster a natural habitat for local wildlife. It is not uncommon to be greeted daily by whitetail deer. (Maybe it wants to join your meeting?) *Lightspeed Systems is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit\-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, or other protected characteristic.*

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer I/II, Applied AI
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** We are growing our Applied AI org and seeking Machine Learning Engineers with expertise in model training, evaluation, and production\-oriented ML systems. You'll work on improving Lila's AI models for customer\-specific scientific needs, with a focus on turning frontier model capabilities into reliable workflows that can be evaluated, iterated, and used in real customer contexts. This is a rare chance to join an early team with the autonomy, flexibility, and compute to tackle frontier science problems. Applied AI sits at the intersection of AI Research, model engineering, and product deployment. The team partners closely with AI Researchers and Software teams to adapt Lila models to customer workflows, improve model quality through experimentation, and ensure model behavior works well end to end inside the application. This role is ideal for someone who can bridge research and engineering: training or adapting models, building evaluation loops, debugging model behavior, and collaborating across AI and Software to move promising capabilities into production\-quality systems. **What You'll Be Building** * Close the last\-mile gap between Lila AI model capabilities and customer\-specific scientific workflows. * Post\-train models using approaches such as SFT and RL (DPO, PPO/GRPO) to align model behavior with customer\-specific requirements and feedback. * Build evaluation loops that measure model quality, reliability, and customer fit. * Design experiments to improve model performance across applied customer use cases. * Feed customer learnings, data signals, and evaluation results back into the Lila AI model improvement cycles. * Partner with AI researchers to translate model improvements into usable capabilities. * Work with Software to integrate model behavior into end\-to\-end product workflows. * Debug model failures using traces, evaluations, customer context, and scientific feedback. * Build reusable tooling for model adaptation, evaluation, and deployment workflows. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Experience building, training, adapting, or evaluating machine learning models. * Strong software engineering skills in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow. * Experience designing experiments, evaluation metrics, or test sets for model performance. * Ability to debug model behavior using data, traces, logs, and qualitative feedback. * Experience working across research and engineering teams to move ML capabilities into usable systems. * Familiarity with large language models, multi\-modal models, or agentic AI systems. * Clear communication skills for translating customer needs into technical model improvements. **Bonus Points For** * Experience adapting models for customer\-facing or production workflows. * Experience with scientific, technical, or data\-intensive customer use cases. * Experience building evaluation harnesses, model monitoring, or quality dashboards. * Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation, tool use, or agentic workflows. * Experience with RL post\-training, such as RLHF, GRPO, or tool\-augmented RL. * Experience training MoE architectures. * Experience working with product or customer\-facing teams to translate needs into ML improvements. **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard\-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai. Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply. **We're All In** Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy. **A Note to Agencies** *Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

jobs.title: Account Executive (AE) | Austin Hybrid (d/f/m)
jobs.description: **About the role** ================== Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain, and we're opening Austin as our first Texas territory. As an Account Executive on the ground here, you'll own the full sales cycle into mid\-market electronics manufacturers across the region — your own pipeline and your own local positioning. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build the territory from nothing.** Find the electronics manufacturing services providers, electronics OEMs, and partners who matter across the region, and make Luminovo a name the local industry recognizes * **Generate your own pipeline.** Calls, email, and LinkedIn, plus the local circuit — trade fairs, hardware meetups, and the Texas manufacturing scene * **Qualify.** Run discovery that gets to a customer's real situation and pain fast, and quantify what solving it is worth to them; SPICED is the framework we sell in * **Prove value.** Run demos built around the pain your buyer actually described, know where we sit against their alternatives, and build the ROI case with our solutions engineers and domain experts * **Close.** Guide the buyer through their own process, turn negotiation into a trade both sides want, and hand off to Customer Success cleanly enough that the value you sold lands * **Own the numbers and write the playbook.** Stay on top of your leading indicators, feed what you learn in the field back to our product team, and turn what works in Austin into what the next hires run **Who you are** --------------- * **You've sold B2B software,** and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took * **You've built something from close to nothing** — a territory, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You're more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one * **You use AI as more than a better search engine.** You've built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it * **You've been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made** — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it's what lets you find the pain before a customer names it * **You're consultative by instinct.** Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo\-ready buyers aren't the motion here * **You're based in Austin.** Year one is local relationship building, and the office is where we're building the US team **Work setup** -------------- Hybrid in Austin alongside our team in New York. We meet regularly in Austin with clear expectations on collaboration days. This role is Austin\-based rather than Texas\-remote. **Travel** ---------- Expect occasional travel for team retreats, US onboarding in New York, and selected industry events. We cover the costs. **Why Luminovo** ---------------- Join a well\-funded SaaS scaleup opening a new market, with the territory and the playbook genuinely yours to build Sell software with measurable impact in a trillion\-dollar industry, backed by solutions engineers and product experts who join your deals Hybrid in Austin with an international, high\-performance team **Whom you’ll be working with** =============================== * Matt, our Sales Lead for North America * Clifton, our VP Sales Global * Max, who is leads our Revenue Operations team and is in charge of our CRM (Hubspot), supporting you with dashboards, sequences, forecasts, and more * Mark, our Head of Marketing, to align on positioning/messaging and drive strategic growth initiatives * Our Sales and Product Team to fully understand our product roadmap, potential constraints, and share product\-related customer feedback **Skills, knowledge, and expertise** ==================================== Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles – see here. **️ About Luminovo** ==================== Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion\-dollar electronics industry. We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress. ***We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.*** To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million. **Our core principles: putting people first \& building great things** As a remote\-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things. We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at. See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor. Compensation Range: $118\.5K \- $218\.2K

jobs.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** M1 Finance has created a personal wealth\-building platform made for the modern era, uniting personal perspective and automated ease. We seamlessly combine free investing and low cost borrowing all in one intuitive, automated Finance Super App, and we’re driven by a mission to empower personal financial well\-being. We believe that financial well\-being is fundamental to overall well\-being, and we strive to deliver products that are simpler, smarter, and stronger than those created by our boring, entrenched, and slow\-moving competitors in the personal finance industry. Our clients have already trusted us with over $12 billion of assets, we’re currently helping hundreds of thousands of people grow and manage their wealth with our industry\-leading automation and tools, and we’re adding thousands of new clients every day. We’re looking for passionate people who want to improve and build on what we’ve created and take responsibility to help others build something meaningful and sustainable for their futures. We mean it when we say, “M1 is yours to build.” If this sounds interesting to you, read on! **Job Description** M1 is hiring a senior IT systems engineer to operate, secure, and continuously improve the IT environment our employees depend on every day, including but not limited to identity and access systems, endpoint management, office infrastructure in Chicago, and the org's SaaS productivity stack. M1 is a fintech firm operating in a heavily regulated industry as a self\-clearing broker\-dealer, so this environment operates under continuous regulatory security and audit obligations. You'll join M1's IT and Security team, own the engineering and security behind this environment, and partner across Compliance, Engineering, and the wider business. We're looking for people energized by solving real problems and having impact, not just by working with interesting technology. You bring real engineering discipline to your work: version control, testing, documentation, and following through until the work is fully done. You automate the toil worth automating rather than than brute\-force the same problem twice. You reach for the right tool for the job, and are comfortable dabbling across the stack: in scripts, APIs, and config\-as\-code. You embrace and use AI judiciously to learn and to move quickly, and exercise good judgment on outputs. **What You'll Do** * Lead identity and access engineering in Okta, our primary IdP: designing SSO, MFA, provisioning and deprovisioning, groups, and access policies around least privilege and separation of duties. * Continuously reduce toil across the environment: automating repetitive provisioning, configuration, and reporting, integrating tools so the same work is never done twice by hand, and maintaining the documentation and runbooks that spread knowledge across the team and cut down common support requests. * Own the security of the IT environment, including but not limited to vulnerability and patch management, endpoint hardening, and a hands\-on role in detecting and responding to issues. * Own the engineering behind workforce enablement: configure and run the SaaS platforms employees depend on and the vendor relationships behind them, manage endpoints (macOS and Windows), and automate onboarding and offboarding so the employee experience scales without adding headcount. * Keep the control environment healthy and provable: run access reviews, maintain configuration standards, asset inventory, and logging, produce the evidence internal and external auditors rely on, and be ready to show how a control actually works. * Serve as escalation path for employee IT support and the Chicago office: fix root causes instead of reworking tickets, and keep the office network, meeting room AV, and physical security (badge access, cameras) running and support in person company events. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years in IT systems engineering or administration, with a track record of owning and improving major parts of an environment independently. * Evidence you can go deep: a system you owned end to end and made materially better, and how you found it, what you changed, and how you knew it worked. Going deep somewhere matters more to us than matching every line below. * Comfortable with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar), REST APIs, and config\-as\-code, applied with an engineer's discipline — source control, meaningful tests, documentation others can follow, and repeatable, auditable processes. * Depth in several of: Okta, SSO, MFA, and identity lifecycle; macOS and Jamf; Microsoft 365; SaaS administration and integration; networking; endpoint security and patching; virtualization and VDI; IT asset lifecycle. * Hands\-on experience designing and operating a hardened office environment: networking and on\-prem infrastructure (LAN and Wi\-Fi, switching, firewalls, VPN) plus physical devices like badge and camera systems, and meeting\-room AV. * Experience in a regulated, security\-conscious, or highly available environment; financial services helpful, not required. *Salary Band: $100,000 \- $130,000* **Additional Information** **Our Values** * **Mission driven:** We know that financial well\-being has a dramatic impact on an individual’s quality of life. We are passionate about helping people in this domain. * **Extreme ownership:** We are responsible for the results to our clients, teammates, and shareholders. We own everything in our domain that affects these results. * **Boldness:** Thinking small is a self\-fulfilling prophecy. Thinking big inspire results. We would rather fail at the meaningful than succeed at the trivial. * **Ruthless prioritization:** We want to do more than we possibly can. We are disciplined with the use of our precious people, time and money. That means saying no to a lot of good ideas so we can focus on the most important thing. * **Integrity:** We earn and maintain trust by always prioritizing our clients’ interests; it must never be compromised. **Our Perks** * Competitive Pay and Stock Options * Comprehensive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance * Retirement benefit with employer match * Unlimited PTO * Transparent and open communication with leadership M1 is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity across the company. M1 does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About MAZO Capital** MAZO Capital LLC is a fast\-growing commercial finance company powering America’s entrepreneurial spirit. We specialize in providing equipment financing and working capital solutions for small and mid\-sized businesses across the U.S. Our mission is to create a better financing experience for our partners and customers through **Trust, Technology, and Transparency.** **Position Overview** We are seeking a motivated and technically curious **Software Engineer** to join our Irvine team. This is MAZO’s first dedicated in\-house engineering role, created to bring the technology that runs our business under one owner. You will take over PAID, our dealer platform, partner with our operations team on Salesforce, and build artificial intelligence and automation directly into the way we originate, underwrite, and fund deals. This role is designed for a recent graduate or early\-career engineer who wants real ownership from day one and direct exposure to how a commercial finance company actually runs. PAID is built on **Python and Django** with a **React** front end, and you will work across both. You do not need prior experience with this exact stack — you need to be someone who can learn it quickly. **What You’ll Do** * Own PAID, our dealer platform — the application our equipment dealer partners use to submit applications, track deal status, and manage their pipeline with MAZO — including the transition from our current outside developer, ongoing maintenance, and new feature development across the Django back end and the React front end. * Support and build within Salesforce, our system of record: Flows, validation rules, reports, permission sets, Lightning Web Components, and API integrations with our lending partners and internal systems. * Design and deploy artificial intelligence and automation directly inside our Python codebase — extracting data from credit applications, bank statements, and equipment invoices; drafting first\-pass credit summaries; automating applicant follow\-up; and routing deals to the right lending partner. * Partner with sales, credit, syndication, and funding to identify manual processes worth automating, then scope, build, and measure the fix. * Maintain integrations across our website, marketing platform, and customer relationship management system. * Document what you build so the business is never dependent on one person’s memory. * Protect confidential customer and financial data in everything you build. **What We’re Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical field — or demonstrable project work in place of a degree. * 0–2 years of professional experience; recent graduates are strongly encouraged to apply. * Working proficiency in Python, including comfort with object\-oriented code and reading someone else’s codebase. * Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, plus hands\-on experience with at least one modern front\-end framework — React preferred, though Vue or Angular experience transfers. * Familiarity with at least one back\-end web framework — Django, Flask, FastAPI, or an equivalent in another language — and with web application fundamentals: application programming interfaces (APIs), relational databases and SQL, authentication, and version control with Git. * Ability to read documentation for an unfamiliar system and get something working independently. * Strong written communication — you will be explaining technical trade\-offs to colleagues in sales and credit who do not write code. * Coachable, self\-directed, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Django and Django REST Framework. * Experience with PostgreSQL, REST API design, or TypeScript. * Exposure to Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow Builder) or another major customer relationship management platform. * Experience building with large language model APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic, including prompt design and evaluating output quality. * Automation platforms such as Make.com, Zapier, or n8n. * Cloud fundamentals on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. * Interest in finance, lending, or business operations. **What You’ll Gain** * Full ownership of production systems the business depends on — not a narrow slice of someone else’s codebase. * Direct exposure to senior leadership across sales, credit, and operations. * Artificial intelligence work that ships to production and gets used the same week, not a pilot program. * Budget and time for certifications, courses, and conferences, including Salesforce credentials. * Breadth across front\-end development, back\-end development, systems integration, data analysis, and AI implementation — plus working knowledge of an entire industry. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Free parking * Health insurance * Life insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager, Frontier Data Products - Multimodal
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real\-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents. Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast\-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in\-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. **About the Role** ------------------ Frontier models increasingly depend on data that goes beyond text: images, video, audio, documents, and combinations of these modalities. Turning that raw material into useful data products is technically difficult. Each modality has different formats, quality failures, processing costs, privacy considerations, and review workflows. The final product still needs to be consistent, traceable, and trustworthy. Mercor’s Frontier Data Products team builds the systems that make these products possible. As Tech Lead Manager, you will lead the team responsible for turning complex multimodal inputs into reliable, customer\-ready data products at scale. This is a player\-coach role, split roughly evenly between technical contribution and people leadership. You will write and review production code, own important architecture decisions, and help resolve the hardest production problems. You will also hire, coach, and organize a team that can operate with clear ownership and strong independent judgment. This is a product\-engineering leadership role. Applied ML is part of the system, but success is measured by the quality, reliability, and usefulness of the products delivered—not by research output alone **What You’ll Do** * Set the technical and product strategy for Mercor’s multimodal data products. * Design systems that support the full lifecycle of image, video, audio, document, and mixed\-media data—from initial inputs through processing, review, validation, versioning, and delivery. * Create reusable abstractions across modalities while preserving the differences that matter for quality, performance, and customer requirements. * Build quality systems that combine automated evaluation, model\-assisted checks, expert review, sampling, and adjudication. * Ensure that every output is traceable: what produced it, what changed, how it was evaluated, and why it was accepted. * Own the reliability, performance, and cost of storage\-heavy, compute\-intensive, long\-running workflows. * Stay hands\-on by writing production code, leading design reviews, and directly contributing to the team’s most consequential technical work. * Manage and develop engineers through clear expectations, frequent feedback, thoughtful delegation, and meaningful ownership. * Partner with product, ML, operations, and customer\-facing teams to turn new customer needs into durable product capabilities rather than one\-off solutions. * Recruit and onboard engineers who raise the team’s technical and execution bar. **What Makes This Role Different** * You will shape both the multimodal product architecture and the engineering team building it. * The technical challenge extends beyond moving large media files. The system must preserve context, relationships, provenance, and quality across different modalities and transformations. * Customer requirements and available models will evolve quickly. The architecture must support new products without requiring the team to rebuild the system for every use case. * The team’s work sits directly between complex real\-world inputs and the data products delivered to frontier AI customers. **What Success Looks Like** * The team can launch support for a new modality or product without building an entirely separate system. * Product quality is measurable, explainable, and auditable across human and model\-assisted workflows. * Large, long\-running jobs are observable and recoverable, with failures detected before they affect customer deliveries. * Customer\-specific work produces reusable capabilities that make the next product faster to build. \- Engineers own substantial areas independently rather than depending on the manager for every technical decision. * The team improves delivery speed while maintaining clear standards for quality, reliability, privacy, and cost. **What We Are Looking For** * Experience managing a strong engineering team while remaining an effective, hands\-on technical leader. * Deep experience designing and operating production backend, distributed, or data\-intensive systems. * Experience working with large unstructured data, asynchronous processing, metadata and versioning, or compute\-heavy workflows. * Relevant experience in at least one area such as multimedia infrastructure, computer\-vision data, video or audio processing, ML platforms, annotation systems, or human\-in\-the\-loop products. * Strong judgment about platform boundaries: what should be generalized across modalities and what should remain modality\-specific. * A track record of taking ambiguous, zero\-to\-one products through architecture, launch, and sustained production operation. * Evidence that you can recruit, coach, and retain excellent engineers while maintaining a high performance bar. **Benefits** * Bi\-annual performance bonus structure * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Up to $15k Relocation bonus * $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0\.5 miles of our office) * $1\.5K monthly stipend for meals * Free Equinox membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance Compensation Range: $300K \- $420K

jobs.title: Sr. Manager Product Design - Games
jobs.description: **Company Description** **CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers. **Job Description** **The Opportunity:** Mattel is looking for an experienced and imaginative Senior Manager, Product Design to help shape the future of one of the world's most iconic games portfolios. From UNO, Pictionary, Scrabble, Phase 10, Skip\-Bo, Blokus, KerPlunk!, and beyond, you'll lead the design of play experiences that entertain millions of players around the world. This is a leadership role for someone who understands that great games don't happen by accident. They are built through thoughtful mechanics, relentless iteration, meaningful playtesting, and exceptional product design. You'll lead a team responsible for transforming ideas into physical products that are intuitive to learn, rewarding to master, and unmistakably Mattel. Working across Design, Marketing, Engineering, Consumer Insights, Packaging, Licensing, and Operations, you'll help define what families and friends will be playing for years to come. **What Your Impact Will Be:** **Gameplay \& Innovation** * Lead the design and development of new gameplay experiences across Mattel's portfolio of family, party, strategy, and trading card games. * Guide projects from early concept exploration through prototyping, playtesting, refinement, and final product execution. * Apply game design principles, player psychology, behavioral science, and consumer insights to create experiences that are simple to learn, rewarding to play, and built for repeat engagement. * Champion rapid prototyping and iterative development, using playtesting and consumer feedback to continuously improve mechanics, pacing, accessibility, and overall player experience. * Identify opportunities to reinvent classic brands while developing entirely new ways to play. **Product Design Excellence** * Lead the physical design of products, translating gameplay into intuitive, beautifully crafted components and experiences. * Partner closely with Engineering and Packaging to balance creativity with manufacturing feasibility, quality, cost, and sustainability. * Drive thoughtful decisions around materials, component design, ergonomics, visual hierarchy, and tactile interaction. * Review prototypes and production samples to ensure the integrity of the gameplay experience is preserved through manufacturing. Creative Leadership * Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Designers, creating an environment where curiosity, experimentation, and creative excellence thrive. * Establish clear priorities while balancing multiple development programs across varying timelines and levels of complexity. * Foster a culture of constructive critique, collaboration, and continuous learning. * Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Consumer Insights, Engineering, Packaging, Licensing, Operations, and external development partners. Execution \& Continuous Improvement * Drive projects from concept through commercialization, ensuring products launch on time, on budget, and at the highest quality standards. * Anticipate risks, solve complex design challenges, and make informed tradeoffs throughout development. * Improve design processes, workflows, and best practices that enable faster innovation and stronger collaboration across the Games organization. **Qualifications** **What We’re Looking For:** * 8\+ years of experience designing tabletop, card, party, strategy, or family games, with a strong understanding of what creates engaging, enduring gameplay. * Experience leading the complete game development process, including ideation, game mechanics, prototyping, playtesting, balancing, iteration, and product commercialization. * 3\+ years of experience leading and developing high\-performing creative teams. * Demonstrated success bringing physical consumer products from concept through manufacturing. * Strong understanding of player motivation, game systems, probability, progression, accessibility, and player experience design. * Knowledge of consumer product development, manufacturing processes, materials, tooling, and production constraints. * Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams and successfully lead complex product development programs. * Strong communication, storytelling, and presentation skills. * Passion for games, curiosity about how people play, and a desire to create products that become part of family traditions. **Bonus Points If You Have** * Experience shipping commercially successful tabl collecting modern board games, or simply believing that bringing people together through play is one of the best jobs in the world. * The pay range is indicative of projected hiring range, however base pay will be determined based on a candidate’s work location, skills and experience. Mattel offers competitive total pay programs, comprehensive benefits, and resources to help empower a culture where every employee can reach their full potential. **Additional Information** Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here! **How We Work:** We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors: * **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower. * **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking. * **We execute:** We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Data Science
jobs.description: Job Description About the Organization The Biologics Science and Technology Platforms, Data, Modeling, and Statistics (PDSM) organization is a highly technical, science\-forward function embedded within Bio S\&T. We partner closely with manufacturing sites, IT, and process engineers to deliver data\-driven process insights, statistical modeling, and digital capabilities that accelerate biologics commercialization and manufacturing excellence. Our mission is to bridge the gap between traditional process engineering and modern data science. We build the foundational architectures, digital workflows, and analytical models that underpin every initiative across the biologics network—enabling proactive process monitoring (PPM), continued process verification (CPV), yield optimization, tech transfer, and AI\-ready manufacturing. We work hand\-in\-hand with our IT and manufacturing partners to co\-design process analytics platforms. Our team contributes deep bioprocessing domain understanding paired with technical data science capabilities, ensuring the right process parameters and quality attributes are captured, contextualized, and modeled to drive real operational outcomes. Position Summary The Senior Specialist, Advanced Process Analytics \& Data Strategy is a technical individual contributor role within PDSM. The primary expectation is hands\-on execution and support, applying data science, process modeling, and data architecture concepts to strengthen biologics manufacturing analytics. The successful candidate will use their bioprocess engineering background to develop, maintain, and improve analytics solutions, support process standardization, and collaborate closely with scientists, engineers, and digital teams. We are seeking candidates who fit the Domain\-to\-Data Professional profile: * A bioprocess, biochemical, or regulated manufacturing engineer who has developed meaningful data science expertise through hands\-on work with process, analytical, and batch data. You must be able to apply tools such as Python, R, SQL, and statistical modeling to support process characterization, digital analytics, root\-cause investigations, and regulatory\-ready manufacturing data products. Key Responsibilities 1\. jobs.title: Full Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- ProductEngineering Overview **You do not need equal depth everywhere. You do need to own the whole result.** At Metaview, full stack does not mean collecting framework keywords. It means one engineer can follow a customer problem across the seams: from the interface to the API, data model, permissions, agent behavior, failure recovery, and production experience. You may be exceptional on one side of the stack. That is useful here. What matters is that you do not treat the other side as someone else’s problem when it stands between you and a great product. **Coding was first. Recruiting is next. We are building it.** ------------------------------------------------------------- Metaview is an applied AI lab building AI coworkers for some of the world’s most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers. The challenge is not another chatbot. It is software that can pursue a hiring objective, act across real workflows, ask for judgment at the right moment, and earn a customer’s trust. Founded by Siadhal Magos and Shahriar Tajbakhsh, who scaled Uber and Palantir, we have raised more than $50M and are growing 5x year over year. AI coding agents are part of the job, not a perk. Engineers routinely run several in parallel for exploration, implementation, and review. We assess both sides of the craft: how well you direct agents and how well you reason, code, and debug on your own. One interview exercise is completed without AI. **Our operating value is velocity** ----------------------------------- Velocity means reducing the time from customer evidence to a reliable product change. It does not mean trading away quality. We ship small changes daily, including Fridays, because the engineer who ships owns production behavior, recovery, and the next revision. Process stays light because customer context and ownership are direct. There is no queue of tickets moving between specialists. You will talk to customers, decide what product primitive solves the problem, build the visible experience and the systems behind it, then stay with the result in production. AI agents help our small team ship roughly 8x more product changes than a year ago. The engineer remains accountable for architecture, review, implementation quality, and production behavior. **What you will build and own** ------------------------------- You will work on problems such as: * building the interface, APIs, data model, permissions, and production behavior of the same customer workflow; * building agents that can pursue recruiting objectives over days, know when to ask for judgment, and recover safely when a model or tool fails; * turning interview and hiring\-team conversations into actions, with interfaces that let recruiters understand, correct, and trust the result; * designing controls and recovery paths for agents acting in customer systems; and * turning repeated product patterns into simple primitives that support many recruiting workflows. In your first 3 to 6 months, you should independently own and ship a bounded customer outcome from problem definition through rollout and iteration. The size of that outcome will reflect your level, but the operating model is the same: make product and technical decisions, contribute the consequential code, and own the production result. **You will probably thrive here if** ------------------------------------ * You have personally shipped software for external users and owned a meaningful outcome from problem definition through production. * You have real depth in at least one technical area and can cross product, frontend, and backend boundaries when the outcome requires it. * You use AI coding agents heavily and can still design, implement, review, and debug independently. * You want direct customer contact, hands\-on implementation, and responsibility after launch. * You enjoy following one product behavior through interface, API, data, permissions, and production recovery. * You move toward the difficult layer rather than routing the problem to another team. This opening spans mid\-level and staff\+ scope under the same hands\-on operating model. At mid\-level, you will independently own a bounded customer outcome across product and implementation. At staff\+, you will still write code while setting direction for a broader area, making hard architectural tradeoffs, and raising the quality of decisions around you. We level on demonstrated scope, not years served. This is a hands\-on product IC role. It is not a people\-management or model\-research role. Our stack includes React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, Postgres, and S3\. Experience with these exact technologies is not required. **What you want to know** ------------------------- * We work together in person in San Francisco. This is not a remote role with occasional office attendance. Decisions are made by the people closest to the customer and the code. Read our unfiltered Slack to see how that works in practice. * We pay in the top 10% of the SF market through salary and meaningful equity. We re\-benchmark against the market twice a year and adjust when compensation drifts. * Our process is fast and direct. It is not unusual to hear back the same day. * Metaview’s internal IC title is **Member of Product Staff, Engineer**. For this opening, level and compensation are set at mid\-level or staff\+ based on demonstrated scope. The work remains hands\-on at every level. * We offer competitive option grants so we are all owners. * We sponsor work visas and support the immigration process from start to finish. * In the US, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents. * Time off is unlimited. Take the time you need.
