jobs.title: Quality Control Manager - QCM
jobs.description: Company Overview Mike Hooks LLC specializes in providing comprehensive dredging services, including maintenance dredging, wetland remediation, beach restoration, and new construction projects. Our fleet of advanced dredges supports a variety of critical infrastructure and environmental initiatives across diverse locations. Job Description As a Mike Hooks Quality Control Manager, you will be an integral part of our marine based dredging company. In this position, you will learn to utilize engineering principles taking part in project layout, topographic and hydrographic surveying, production guidance, monitoring, reporting, and dredging quality control. You will have the opportunity to collaborate and work with other talented team members. This position will report directly to a senior level Field Engineer. Division Overview Mike Hooks is a respected marine contractor that owns, operates, and maintains a diverse and extensive fleet of dredging and support equipment. We serve customers that require dredging for navigation and restoration, in turn maintaining the waterways that transport goods and fortifying our infrastructure and coastlines. Mike Hooks provides a cohesive dredging services lifecycle. We specialize in both capital and maintenance dredging for deep or shallow draft navigation, as well as coastal restoration and protection. The division employs a talented and motivated workforce that includes managers, engineers, technicians, and support personnel — all with experience and qualifications that are second to none. Our primary objective is to deliver exceptional customer service in the spirit of partnership, while upholding the highest levels of safety, environmental sensitivity, and operational efficiency. This is an hourly position that pays overtime if working more than 40 hours in a work week. Essential Job Functions * Train to increase scope of knowledge, skills and understanding of Hydrographic surveying and reporting requirements * Train to provide dredge with accurate surveys and vessel guidance to ensure accurate production measurements and correct location of channel, as per contract * Train to provide hydrographic surveys required for project monitoring and payment quantities * Assist in maintaining accurate documentation of survey activities * Develop understanding of survey activities * Provide daily support of dredge procurement requirements * Assist in the generation of daily reports and assembly and maintenance of proper job records * Provide support in the maintenance of vehicle and equipment assigned to project QC Manager The QC Manager is responsible for overseeing the quality control aspects of the project, ensuring compliance with environmental requirements, contract specifications, dredge operations compliance, submittal management, and overall coordination and planning. The QC Manager would need a broad view of the project to manage and strategize effectively. * **Reporting**: Geological Classification of Soil Types, Environmental Requirements, Effective Narrative Composition, DPR * **Contract/Specifications**: Understanding all contract types, dredging templates, pay items/reaches, identifying submittal items, personnel requirements, and other contract requirements * **Dredge Operations**: Overseeing safety, environmental compliance, upland placement/weir boxes, beach fill, marsh creation, open water placement, pipeline types, discharge methods/attachments * **Submittals**: Identifying per contract requirements, managing (including spear\-pointing those prepared by others), reviewing, RMS (Creating Register, Submitting Transmittals) * **CQM/Three\-Phase System**: Overseeing the phases (Preparatory, Initial, Follow\-up), preparing agendas/conducting meetings, certification * **Coordination**: Supervisor/Project Manager (with Surveys, Production, Submittals, Schedule, Contract Requirements, Needs), Captain (with Daily Operations, Surveys/Cross Sections, Run Time \& Non\-Effective Time, Placement Areas/Locations/Requirements, Upcoming Work) * **Planning**: Identifying Required Survey Reaches, Forecasting Based on Production/Experience * **Conduct/Professionalism**: Overseeing attendance, timeliness, quality of work, safety performance, cooperation with supervisor/co\-workers, work ethic, correspondence, software literacy Level I (Entry Level): * Compliance Rate: Percentage of projects meeting environmental requirements and contract specifications. * Submittal Accuracy: Accuracy and completeness of submittals as per contract requirements. * Coordination Effectiveness: Ability to coordinate with project managers, supervisors, and other stakeholders. * Safety Incidents: Adherence to safety protocols and reduction of safety incidents. * Timeliness of Meetings: Organization and punctuality in preparing and conducting meetings. Level II (Proven Competency): * Quality Control Improvement Initiatives: Implementation of process improvements leading to enhanced quality control. * Project Efficiency: Streamlining processes to improve project efficiency while maintaining quality standards. * Leadership and Team Management: Effective leadership of QC teams, including mentorship and conflict resolution. * Strategic Planning: Contribution to strategic planning based on project experience and knowledge. * Client Satisfaction: Feedback from clients regarding communication, responsiveness, and problem\-solving. Level III (Exceptional Performance): * Cross\-Department Collaboration: Collaboration with other departments to optimize project performance. * Team Development: Contribution to the professional development and growth of QC team members. * Problem\-solving: Ability to identify and solve complex project\-related issues effectively. * Continued Professional Development: Pursuit of advanced certifications and training to stay ahead in the field. * Management Skills: Advanced effective communication with stakeholders to ensure project success. Qualifications * Proficient skills in standard office software packages * Ability to be trained to utilize current surveying equipment and techniques * Willingness and ability to travel required * Ability to work 84\-hour work week. 14 days on, 7 days off, revised as necessary * Ability to live aboard vessel for full rotation Required Certifications or Licenses * Driver’s license with clean driving record Physical Requirements * Must successfully complete pass a post\-offer physical * Must be able to tolerate rough seas, vibrations, heat, harsh weather conditions, confined spaces, and high noise levels * Work will frequently require individuals to push, pull, bend, sit or stand for long periods of time, and climb ladders * Must be able to lift or carry miscellaneous equipment, supplies, and parts, up to 50 lbs. unassisted This Job Description does not cover all the required duties, activities, functions, and responsibilities of the position, any of which may change at any time according to the sole and absolute discretion of Mike Hooks LLC with or without notice. Acquire knowledge and maintain an understanding of Milwaukee Tool’s development and manufacturing processes to effectively and efficiently mass produce power tools. * **What TOOLS** **you’ll** **bring with you:** * Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field. * 2\+ years of experience in testing printed circuit board assemblies. * Excellent HW / F W problem\-solving skills, exercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment. * Self\-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic. * Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international). **Other** **TOOLS** **we prefer you to have:** * Knowledge of test and measurement techniques, including sensor technology, signal conditioning, measuring techniques, data acquisition and performance calculations. * Ability to understand and develop schematics for PCBAs. * Experience with programming languages such as LabView, C, Python, and experience working with Arduino platform. * Working knowledge of Design of Experiments (DOE) analytical techniques. * Knowledge of electronic component reliability and failure modes. * Knowledge in HW Manual testing is preferred. Experience with soldering and wiring preferred. * **We provide these great** **perks** **and benefits:** * Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. * Generous 401 (K) savings plan. * Education assistance . * On\-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service. jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 15 Sep 2026 At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. **About the Role** ================== MiniMed is building a lean, high\-leverage AI \& Data Science team. We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to be our senior technical anchor — the person who builds AI capabilities hands\-on and sets the standard the rest of the team builds to. This is a builder’s role first. You will take AI/ML models and LLM\-powered agents from a fast “proof of life” prototype through to a production deployment that holds up in a regulated environment. Roughly a fifth of your time goes to the force\-multiplier work: reviewing and quality\-gating other engineers’ designs, and establishing the reusable patterns that keep the architecture and the hard\-won judgment in\-house. To be clear about what this is not: this is not a people\-management role, and it is not a role where you hand a notebook to someone else to productionize. You own the capability until it is live and delivering value. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. **Prototype fast.** Demonstrate “proof of life” for AI/ML models, agents, and tools against real MiniMed business problems, working from the business’s actual data and workflows rather than a sanitized sandbox. **Take it to production and drive adoption.** Build, evaluate, and deploy on the MIA stack (Databricks, LangGraph/LangSmith, enterprise agent platforms), applying evaluation\-driven development, guardrails, and deployment patterns so what ships is reliable, auditable, and maintainable. You own the capability from prototype through initial production release and its first monitoring cycle — measured by real adoption and business value, not just a stable deployment — then hand off to Model Operations for steady\-state run. **Integrate into the enterprise environment.** Wire agents and models into the surrounding systems — APIs, identity and access (SSO/SAML/OAuth), systems of record such as Salesforce and SAP, and enterprise data pipelines — so capabilities work against real, messy production systems rather than in isolation. **Set the technical standard.** Establish reusable patterns for agent design, tool\-calling, retrieval, and evaluation harnesses; review and quality\-gate the work of other engineers on the team so the bar holds without a manager in the loop. **Feed learnings back to the platform.** Turn what you learn in the field into improvements to the MIA platform, shared tooling, and reusable\-pattern roadmap, so each deployment makes the next one faster. **Self\-direct against outcomes.** Partner with the Product Manager, AI \& Data Science to choose what to build and when to stop, without needing the problem pre\-decomposed for you. **Build for a regulated environment.** Uphold the safety, privacy, and compliance requirements of a medical\-device context, including auditability and human\-in\-the\-loop where required. **Must Have: and end\-to\-end ownership from prototype through production deployment. * Experience technically leading or directing other engineers, including reviewing their work. * Strong stakeholder\-facing communication — able to scope ambiguous problems with business partners and explain technical trade\-offs (latency, cost, model risk) to non\-technical leaders. * Hands\-on with Databricks, LangGraph, LangSmith, vector databases, and managed RAG/retrieval. * Forward\-deployed or embedded engineering experience — building AI systems from inside the business’s real data, workflows, and constraints. * Experience integrating AI or software systems into complex enterprise environments — APIs, identity/auth, systems of record (e.g., Salesforce, SAP), and data pipelines. * Comfort operating within a formal MLOps discipline, including a defined handoff to a model operations function. * Experience in a regulated industry (medical device, healthcare, financial services); familiarity with HIPAA, audit, and validation requirements. **Physical Job Requirements** ============================= The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. The physical demands described wi ve salary and flexible benefits package** At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$138,000\.00 \- $234,000\.00 For roles located in California, Seattle WA, Washington DC, Boston MA, and New York City, the salary range is $ 153,000\.00 \- $261,000\.00 USD. jobs.title: Engineer III, Gas Turbine Fluid Systems
jobs.description: **Gas Turbine Fluid Systems Engineer III** **Company Overview** At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. This intermediate\-level engineering role supports existing fielded systems, develops modifications to resolve operational issues, and designs new systems for blended hydrogen fuels, emissions control, alternate fuels, power augmentation, and turndown applications. The position combines process, piping, equipment, controls, commissioning, and project engineering responsibilities across the full project lifecycle while contributing to safe, repeatable fluid system improvements that support the transition to a net\-zero carbon future. **Key Responsibilities** * Oversee the design and development of auxiliary systems for gas turbines in accordance with established standard operating procedures. * Perform feasibility, front\-end engineering design, and detailed engineering studies. * Specify vendor requirements for pumps, valves, compressors, heat exchangers, skids, instrumentation, pipe supports, and related components while ensuring compliance with codes, contracts, and internal standards. * Prepare process engineering calculations and supporting technical documentation. * Analyze flow networks using AFT Arrow and AFT Fathom. * Develop and interpret Process Flow Diagrams and P\&IDs using SmartPlant P\&ID. * Prepare piping engineering calculations and documentation. * Use 3D piping design tools such as PDS, PDMS, SmartPlant 3D, or Creo Piping to develop system layouts and routing. * Use 3D laser scan data to support new designs and avoid clashes. * Perform or review pipe stress analysis using CAESAR II and/or AutoPIPE. * Analyze and select pipe supports and apply piping materials and class requirements. * Prepare plot plans, piping arrangements, isometrics, construction drawings, and spool drawings for field and shop fabrication. * Support Hazard and Operability Studies. * Interpret ASME B31\.1, B31\.3, and B31\.12 requirements and ensure piping code requirements are incorporated into designs and vendor specifications. * Prepare Bills of Materials, installation documentation, operator manuals, and training materials. * Provide site support for operator training, commissioning, startup, and troubleshooting. * Standardize auxiliary system designs for efficient deployment across customers and projects. * Support ISO 9001 audits, compliance activities, documentation improvements, and configuration control methods. * Lead or support root cause analysis and diagnostic activities for auxiliary systems experiencing field issues during service operation. * Use product lifecycle and requirements management tools, including Windchill. * Support EPC project execution and contract requirements. * Comply with safety policies, protect confidential information, and maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity. * Travel domestically and internationally 10% to 20%, including occasional trips lasting two or more weeks. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Requirements** * Master's degree preferred or bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited college or university. * A minimum of six (6\) years of engineering design experience required; a minimum of twelve (12\) years of directly related experience may substitute for the degree requirement. * Relevant graduate coursework and project experience may be considered toward the experience requirement. * Knowledge of gas turbine engineering, including turbine configuration, design, boundary conditions, temperatures, and materials. * Experience with process engineering, piping design, equipment specification, controls integration, commissioning, and project execution. * Knowledge of product lifecycle management and requirements management systems. * Demonstrated leadership skills in short\-term critical\-path development programs. * Ability to manage workload, priorities, and technical decisions while coordinating with appropriate team members. * Ability to read and interpret industry reports, technical journals, specifications, and engineering documentation. * Ability to prepare technical reports and customer correspondence and present information to individuals and groups. * Ability to perform engineering calculations and make sound technical judgments based on specifications and requirements. * Advanced computer skills involving piping route, stress, and flow analysis, spreadsheets, ERP systems, electronic mail, word processing, and presentation software. * United States citizenship or permanent legal residency required to fulfill the job function. **Why Should You Apply?** * Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision \& 401K Matching). * Excellent development programs and advancement opportunities. * Tuition reimbursement and on\-the\-job training. * Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays. * Committed to quality products and services. * Great working environment and culture. * Employee Appreciation Programs and Event. Mitsubishi Power is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer actively seeking to diversify the workforce and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. Therefore, all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under applicable law, are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.description: This position is responsible for the heating and ventilating operations for the MSU campus which includes the operation, preventive maintenance, and repair of facility air\-handling/heating systems. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Responsible for maintenance of the following: HVAC systems, pneumatic/electric/electronic controls, building management systems, energy accessories, heating loop systems, pumps, compressors, valves, motors, meters, heat exchangers. * The person in this position may work individually or as a team member as job conditions demand. * jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering - Parametric
jobs.description: ABOUT MORGAN STANLEY Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com. ABOUT PARAMETRIC Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week. ABOUT THE TEAM The Accounting Platforms team at Parametric: * Is accountable for the reliability and strategic evolution of the accounting platforms Parametric's investment business depends on \- a portfolio of vendor\-provided, third\-party systems alongside one platform built and maintained internally by Parametric engineering teams. * Ensures the accounting platforms support the full breadth of the business: equities, fixed income, options, and derivatives, across both domestic and international investment strategies. * Owns these platforms end to end: operational health and vendor relationships on one side, and the software that integrates them on the other. * Is leading a multi\-year initiative to align accounting capabilities with Radius, Parametric's strategic platform, so the business operates on vendor\-neutral workflows and services. Works directly with business leaders, solution managers, accounting data consumers, and hundreds of platform users, because the change it is delivering is as much a change to business workflow as it is to software. * ABOUT THE ROLE The Accounting Platforms team is accountable for the operation, stability, and strategic evolution of Parametric's accounting systems. The Manager, Software Engineering will lead the engineering team responsible for these platforms \- owning delivery, operations, and people leadership across a portfolio that spans platform reliability, business\-as\-usual demand, and a multi\-year modernization initiative. Parametric's business is growing quickly, and the manager is accountable for ensuring the accounting platforms scale to match \- supporting higher transaction volumes and data throughput efficiently and without sacrificing reliability. This is a hands\-on technical delivery leadership position \- a management role that stays close to the technical detail, engaged in options, design review, and platform behavior, rather than serving as the team's expert engineer. The role leads the discovery and organizational change that alignment requires, and it is accountable for the two engineering capabilities on which it depends: making high\-value accounting datasets available to the business consumers who need them, and the Radius Accounting Service, whose APIs and Kafka interfaces expose accounting capability in Parametric's own trade and transaction language rather than any accounting platform's. This role requires a leader who can establish direction, build alignment across business and technology stakeholders, and drive execution across a portfolio of operational, strategic, and technology initiatives. Success depends on balancing platform stability, operational risk, business priorities, and long\-term modernization efforts. The role partners closely with a Principal Software Engineer who provides architectural leadership and technical direction, and together they guide technology decisions, delivery priorities, and platform evolution. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES **Delivery and portfolio** * Own a single visible, prioritized portfolio spanning platform operations, BAU demand, and strategic transition, and hold the trade\-offs between them. * Own the intake\-to\-delivery process \- sizing, decision rights, stakeholder commitment, and delivery reporting \- and keep it fit for purpose as demand changes. **Platform operations** * Own the operational health of the accounting platforms: reliability, monitoring and alerting, runbooks, incident response and review, known\-risk tracking, and escalation paths both internally and to vendors. * Serve as Primary IT System Owner for the accounting platforms, including data lifecycle management, access controls, audit support, and business continuity and disaster recovery. * Own the working vendor relationships for the vendor\-provided and vendor\-hosted a , development planning, and hiring. * Experience scaling a platform's capacity and throughput to keep pace with rapid business growth, while maintaining efficiency and reliability. **Preferred Skills** * Investment accounting or financial services domain experience; familiarity with portfolio accounting platforms such as Advent APX or comparable systems. * Experience owning a vendor\-provided or vendor\-hosted platform, including vendor escalation and upgrade management. * Experience delivering data products consumed by business teams under agreed accuracy, timeliness, and performance commitments. * Experience decomposing dependencies on a legacy system into an incremental, business\-approved transition program. Experience leading teams building cloud\-native services (AWS preferred), including CI/CD and infrastructure as code. * Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services. **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:** At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser. Salary range for the position: $115,000 \- $225,000/Yr. The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary incentive compensation award. The successful candidate may be eligible to participate in the relevant business unit's incentive compensation plan, which also may include a discretionary bonus component. Morgan Stanley offers a full spectrum of benefits, including Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Dependent Day Care Savings Account, Life Insurance, Disability and Other Insurance Plans, Paid Time Off (including Sick Leave consistent with state and local law, Parental Leave and 20 Vacation Days annually), 10 Paid Holidays, 401(k), and Short/Long Term Disability, in addition to other special perks reserved for our employees. Please visit mybenefits.morganstanley.com to learn more about our benefit offerings. Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences. For more information, please visit : https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo .

jobs.title: Staff Design Release Engineer, Human-Machine Interface & User Experience
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** Our Design Release Engineering team, within the Vehicle Platform Engineering group, is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to own the complete design release, engineering integration, and OEM orchestration of our Human\-Machine Interface (HMI) and User Experience (UX) subsystem. This role fuses traditional Design Release Engineering with hands\-on Product Management and Systems Engineering. As the primary engineering authority, you will drive the translation of high\-level user experience concepts into actionable technical requirements, lead component procurement, and manage the complete release and vehicle integration of passenger and exterior\-facing HMI systems. **What You'll Be Doing:** * **Own the complete design release** for all in\-cabin and exterior HMI hardware components, including passenger displays, status indicators, buttons and key pads, and speakers and microphones. * **Drive requirements and product definition alignment** by collaborating closely with internal teams to convert high\-level driverless user experience concepts into detailed engineering specifications, interface control documents (ICDs), and functional requirements. * **Lead end\-to\-end technical execution** for the full product lifecycle, from concept and architecture definition to sustaining engineering and continuous improvement. * **Oversee the generation and release** of all engineering documentation, including drawings, Bills of Material (BOM), specifications, and test reports. * **Drive OEM platform integration** by working directly with the vehicle manufacturer's engineering teams to facilitate the mechanical, electrical, and software integration of Motional's HMI suite into the OEM's base vehicle architecture. * **Define and maintain the Design Verification Plan \& Report (DVP\&R)**, ensuring successful validation against system performance targets. * **Lead the Engineering Change (ECN) process** for all HMI modules, ensuring traceability, cost impact analysis, version control, and full cross\-functional buy\-in. * **Act as the primary technical and program interface** to suppliers (Tier 1 and Tier 2\), tracking part maturity through DV, PV, and PPAP phases to ensure tooling and delivery readiness. * **Lead technical program reviews and design readiness assessments**, proactively developing risk mitigation plans to ensure HMI hardware maturity aligns with program milestones and build events. * **Provide regular, concise updates** to technical leadership on design maturity, validation progress, open issues, and timely closure metrics. **What We're Looking For:** * 8\+ years of experience in automotive hardware design and release engineering, with direct ownership of infotainment, displays, cabin electronics, or HMI platforms. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer, or Systems Engineering (or a related technical field). * Strong ability to bridge the gap between abstract UX/Product vision and rigorous automotive engineering requirements, with a proven track record of managing release timelines, vendor delivery, and OEM integration milestones. * Deep technical understanding of automotive display technologies, touch interfaces, audio systems, lighting, and in\-cabin communication protocols. * Fundamental knowledge of validation documentation and processes, including DVP\&R, DFMEA, and PFMEA. * Expert\-level experience with the manufacturing BOM and ECN processes, and a proven ability to manage technical discussions with external suppliers. * Familiarity with CAD systems (e.g., NX, CATIA), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems (including requirement management tools such as Polarion), and engineering release workflows. * Strong understanding of vehicle integration, packaging, and functional safety standards (ISO 26262\). * Proven ability to lead complex initiatives, manage cross\-functional teams, and execute to aggressive program timelines with minimal oversight. **Bonus Points:** * Professional proficiency or fluency in Korean to facilitate direct technical and program communication with international vehicle manufacturing partners. * Hands\-on experience defining or testing passenger\-facing UX/HMI modules specifically tailored for autonomous vehicles, robotaxis, or shared mobility fleets. * Prior experience working within an automotive OEM (or managing large\-scale platform integrations as a strategic Tier 1 partner), with a proven track record of navigating vehicle assembly plants, OEM launch milestones, and joint\-venture automotive program delivery. **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Mural Group is partnering with a precision CNC machining shop in Hamilton, Ohio to find an Automation Engineer who wants to do meaningful work at the intersection of robotics, advanced machining, and manufacturing engineering. This shop serves aerospace, defense, energy, and turbomachinery customers with close\-tolerance components machined from difficult materials. Automation is not an afterthought here; it is a core part of how they compete and grow. They run robotic work cells, lights\-out machining programs, and Matsuura 5\-axis platforms integrated with automation systems, and they are looking for an engineer who can own, expand, and improve that infrastructure. **What You Will Own** * Design, program, integrate, and commission automated manufacturing work cells, including robotic loading and unloading systems, pallet automation, and lights\-out machining configurations * Develop and maintain robot programs (FANUC, Makino, or comparable platforms) and integrate them with CNC machine controls * Partner with machinists, programmers, and shop leadership to identify automation opportunities that improve throughput, reduce labor dependency, and increase capacity utilization * Troubleshoot and resolve automation system issues on live production equipment; You write clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript even without an AI coding assistant, with front\-end framework experience a plus. Using Git is second nature to you. + Experience with one or more LLM\-based coding assistants is strongly encouraged, such as: Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor + Experience with some of the following technologies is a plus, but not required: Microsoft Azure, Linux systems administration, Vue.js, TypeScript, Elasticsearch, Docker, PostgreSQL, Jenkins, Salesforce, Sentry, HubSpot, or Celery/RabbitMQ. * **You have experience with government and elections**: The idea of getting immersed in campaign finance data, election visualizations, and politics is compelling to you (rather than a turn\-off). You are organized, focused, and detail\-oriented. * **You communicate and work well with others**: You exhibit good communications skills and collaboration habits, both written and verbally, by providing accurate time and effort estimates and working to ensure the team meets agreed\-upon deadlines. You are comfortable working with product and project managers to plan weekly sprints, capable of prioritizing and undertaking multiple projects at once, and familiar with Agile development methodologies. When needed, you are cool under pressure. * **You demonstrate good judgment**: Colleagues can count on you to apply critical thinking to tasks and find creative ways to solve problems. You appreciate both short\-term and long\-term implications when making decisions and act as a responsible gatekeeper when critiquing new code, whether hand\-written or AI\-suggested. * **You'll bring something new to the team**: We value having a team with diverse skills and experiences. Do you have a background in accessibility technologies, robotics, or AI\-generated jokes? Are you active in a local user group, open source effort, or side project of your own? Passion for learning new things (whether technology\-related or not) is most welcome. * **You value a healthy work\-life balance**: You keep high standards and work hard, yet know when to take breaks, switch gears, and unplug, with the ability to manage your time effectively to preserve those boundaries. **Compensation:** $100,000\+, commensurate with experience. **Application Deadline:** September 30, 2026 **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Full\-time telework/remote arrangements are offered for U.S. candidates residing in the following locations: Washington DC, Maryland, Virginia, or California. jobs.title: Manager, Autonomy Evaluation, Data & Test
jobs.description: **Who we are** Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America's drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high\-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands\-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment. As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We're hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years. **What you will be doing** Neros builds autonomy for drones that operate in contested environments where GPS and communications are denied. The Autonomy Evaluation, Data \& Test team owns how autonomy performance is measured across all Neros platforms: the regression and simulation infrastructure every software change is tested against, the data platform that ingests and indexes flight logs, the hardware\-in\-the\-loop bench, and field test operations. As the leader of this team, you will define the metrics and acceptance criteria that determine whether autonomy software is cleared to fly, and build the team and systems that produce that evidence. * Own the release criteria for autonomy software, including the definition of the regression gate, the conditions under which a build is blocked, and the process for reviewing exceptions * Define autonomy performance metrics and their semantics for the organization, and publish coverage and reliability reporting to engineering and company leadership * Build and operate a multi\-tier regression system spanning unit and module tests, open\-loop replay against logged flights, closed\-loop simulation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing on production flight computers, including latency and deadline\-miss measurement on target hardware * Own the autonomy data platform end to end: on\-vehicle capture, field egress, ingest and normalization, log catalog and query layer, deterministic replay at scale, and versioned dataset materialization for model training * Direct field test and autonomy integration, including instrumented test articles, autonomy payload integration, range operations, log recovery, and flight\-readiness execution * Hire, lead, and develop a team of engineers spanning software infrastructure, data engineering, simulation, and physical test **You should have the following** * 8\+ years of engineering experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, aerospace, or defense autonomy, including 3\+ years managing engineers * Direct experience leading an evaluation, validation, metrics, or test infrastructure function for a physical autonomous system * Demonstrated experience defining performance metrics and acceptance criteria for autonomy or machine learning systems, and owning release gating decisions * Hands\-on experience building automated regression and CI infrastructure for robotics or autonomy software, in Python and C\+\+ * Experience with large\-scale log and sensor data infrastructure: ingest pipelines, time alignment across sensors, cataloging and query over multi\-terabyte unstructured video and telemetry data, and deterministic replay * Working knowledge of closed\-loop simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, including real\-time latency budgets and timing measurement on embedded compute * Experience managing engineers across more than one discipline, including at least one outside your own technical background * BS or MS in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field **Nice to Have** * Experience building evaluation, simulation, or data infrastructure from the ground up at an autonomous vehicle, drone, or robotics company, rather than operating an established system * Experience with machine learning data pipelines, including dataset versioning and lineage, labeling operations, and large\-scale automated model evaluation * Experience supporting or leading flight test and range operations, including instrumented test articles, test article turnaround, and flight\-readiness review processes * Background in guidance, navigation and control, multi\-target tracking, sensor fusion, or electro\-optical and infrared perception in maritime or air\-to\-air domains **US Salary Range** $191,500 – $268,000 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package. We're an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. **About the Team** Ads Data Engineering is at the core of building a data ecosystem that powers Netflix's understanding and decision\-making about the impact of ads on our business. This team builds rich, connected, and easily accessible data products spanning ad inventory, forecasting, targeting, ad serving, pacing, and more. This role will lead the Ads Signals \& Measurement team across three core areas: * Conversion \& Attribution: Building the data and attribution capabilities that connect advertising exposure to outcomes, powering conversion measurement and ML\-based optimization. * Measurement Data Foundations: Building the data foundations that power our first\-party measurement solutions across the full funnel, including incrementality, lift, experimentation, and third\-party measurement studies. * Audience Onboarding \& Identity: Enabling audience onboarding, identity resolution, and rich signal generation to power audience and targeting solutions. Horizontally, the team connects these areas through a data flywheel where signals, identity, measurement, attribution, and optimization continuously reinforce one another. This role sits at the intersection of these domains, ensuring they come together as a cohesive data ecosystem that powers both measurement and performance optimization. We're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to help set the technical bar and lead teams across these domains. **Who are you?** * A seasoned technologist with 12\+ years building data\-foundation, backend, or data engineering systems, someone other engineers naturally look to for direction. * You've spent real time in advertising or ad\-tech data, specifically in domains like Ads identity graph, measurement, targeting, and while your depth may run deepest in one domain, you're comfortable moving across several. * You've built trust and driven technical direction across organizational lines, not just within your own team, and you've done it in more than one company or role. * You take data privacy and governance seriously, not as a checkbox, but as something you've actually built for. * You're a clear, thoughtful communicator who can translate technical nuance for engineers and business context for leaders, often in the same conversation. * You're comfortable with ambiguity, and just as comfortable helping a room of smart, opinionated engineers land on a shared answer. * You genuinely enjoy helping other engineers grow, and see that as just as core to the job as your own technical output. **What will you do?** * Set technical direction and design coherence across the various orgs, connecting the dots between domains rather than optimizing just one. * Weigh in on and help resolve cross\-domain design decisions, helping teams converge on approaches that scale across the org, not just within a single team. * Mentor and coach data engineers, helping them grow technically and adopt AI and emerging tools and technologies. * Build strong partnerships with senior engineers on our data platform and D\&I teams, contributing to and shaping horizontal and platform\-wide efforts. **What (ideally) do you know?** * Modern data stacks end\-to\-end: ingestion, processing, storage, and serving. * Ad\-tech systems and data flows, ideally with direct exposure to at least 2 domains across measurement, attribution, identity , audience, targeting * Large\-scale distributed data systems such as Spark, Kafka, or columnar stores. * The latest in AI and agentic technologies as they apply to data engineering. * A graduate degree in Computer Science with a data focus is a plus, as is experience formally mentoring engineers on their technical growth. jobs.description: We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. We operate a fleet of Kubernetes\-managed services built primarily in Java, with Kafka as the backbone for inter\-service communication and a cell\-based architecture. If the idea of working on complex systems that process millions of messages per second and handle petabytes of data excites you, then you may be an excellent fit! **What you'll do** * Weigh tradeoffs GA * Evaluate and introduce new tools, patterns, and technologies for the team — including LLM\-assisted development practices where they are a logical fit * Stay hands\-on — write and ship production on * Own the operational health of the systems you lead — CI/CD, observability, and incident response * Spot gaps in our tools, documentation, or team coverage — and make sure they get closed **This comparable OOP language, with the ability to ramp quickly across other languages and frameworks the team uses * Experience running stateful distributed services in production under unpredictable load, jobs.description: Technical Co\-Founder / Founding Engineer **Early\-Stage Education Technology Startup** **Compensation:** Primarily Equity\-Based **Position:** Co\-Founder / Founding Technical Lead **Schedule:** Flexible **Location:** Remote / Hybrid/ Columbus, OH (preferred but will hire best candidate) About the Company We are an early\-stage education technology startup building a new platform designed to help students explore careers, understand professional pathways, and make more informed decisions about their futures. The product combines interactive digital experiences, artificial intelligence, career exploration tools, simulations, personalized recommendations, and student\-focused content into a single platform. An initial version of the platform has already been developed. We are now looking for a highly motivated **Technical Co\-Founder / Founding Engineer** who can help take ownership of the technology, strengthen the existing product, and build the technical foundation for future growth. This is not a traditional salaried software engineering position. It is intended for someone interested in joining an early\-stage company as a technical founder and building meaningful ownership through equity. What You'll Do You will work directly with the founder to help shape both the product and technical direction of the company. Key responsibilities may include: * Review, improve, maintain, and expand the existing application and codebase. * Lead development of new platform features from concept through deployment. * Build and integrate AI\-powered features using large language models (LLMs) and third\-party APIs. * Develop scalable backend systems, APIs, databases, authentication, and application infrastructure. * Improve frontend functionality, responsiveness, performance, and user experience. * Develop interactive experiences, simulations, dashboards, and student\-facing tools. * Help establish the company's long\-term technical architecture and development standards. * Troubleshoot bugs, security issues, performance problems, and production issues. * Translate creative product concepts into functional prototypes and production\-ready features. * Help determine what should be built internally versus through external APIs, models, or infrastructure. * As the company grows, potentially help recruit and lead future engineering and product team members. Technical Skills We're Looking For You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed below. We care most about strong engineering fundamentals, versatility, creativity, and the ability to learn quickly. Experience with several of the following is preferred: **Programming \& Development** * Python * JavaScript and/or TypeScript * React or similar modern frontend frameworks * Node.js and modern web application development * Java * C\+\+ * HTML/CSS * REST APIs and third\-party API integrations * SQL and/or modern database technologies * Git and version control **AI \& LLM Development** * Experience integrating large language models into applications * OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or similar AI APIs * Prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs * AI agents, tool/function calling, or workflow automation * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) or vector databases * Designing AI systems with appropriate reliability, privacy, cost, and safety considerations **Platform \& Infrastructure** * Replit or similar cloud development environments * Cloud deployment and hosting * Authentication and user\-management systems * Database architecture * API development * Application security * Performance optimization * SaaS architecture Experience building educational technology, gamified applications, interactive simulations, 3D/web experiences, or AI\-powered consumer products would be particularly valuable. Creative Product \& Design This role goes beyond writing code. We are looking for someone who enjoys asking, **"How could we make this experience better?"** You should be comfortable contributing ideas around: * UI/UX * Product design * Gamification * Interactive experiences * Student engagement * AI experiences * Visual storytelling * Prototyping * Creative feature development Experience with Figma, WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber, game development, 3D environments, or similar creative technologies is a plus, but not required. Who We're Looking For The ideal person is entrepreneurial and wants meaningful ownership rather than simply another engineering assignment. You may be a strong fit if you: * Want to help build a company from an early stage. * Enjoy moving quickly and solving ambiguous problems. * Can independently turn ideas into working products. * Are comfortable working with an evolving codebase. * Think about users and business outcomes in addition to engineering. * Have strong product instincts and creative problem\-solving skills. * Are excited about AI, education, career exploration, and emerging technology. * Communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical collaborators. * Want the opportunity to influence the company's technology, product, and long\-term direction. Startup experience is valuable but not required. Compensation \& Ownership This is an **early\-stage co\-founder opportunity in which equity is expected to be the primary form of compensation initially**. The specific ownership structure, responsibilities, vesting schedule, time commitment, and future compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates and documented through appropriate agreements. Candidates should understand that early\-stage startups involve significant uncertainty and risk. Equity does not guarantee future compensation or company value. As the company reaches appropriate revenue or financing milestones, the founders may evaluate transitioning the role to include cash compensation. Why Join? This is an opportunity to become a foundational member of a company rather than joining after the major product and technology decisions have already been made. The right person will have the opportunity to meaningfully influence: * Product direction * Technology architecture * AI strategy * User experience * Engineering culture * Future hiring * Company strategy Most importantly, you will be helping build technology intended to give students greater exposure to careers and opportunities before they have to make major educational and professional decisions. How to Apply Please submit a resume, LinkedIn profile, GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of products you have built. In your application, briefly tell us: * What have you built that you're most proud of? * What technologies do you consider your strongest? * What experience do you have building with LLMs or AI APIs? * Have you ever taken an application from prototype to production? * Why does joining an early\-stage company as a technical co\-founder interest you? * What level of time commitment could you realistically make? We care more about **what you can build, how you think, and your desire to create something meaningful** than a specific degree or traditional career path. Pay: $8\.00 \- $10\.00 per hour Expected hours: 37\.5 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in Columbus, OH 43268

jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality & Resolution
jobs.description: **Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality \& Resolution** **Role Purpose** The Senior Support Engineer is responsible for investigating and resolving complex product\-data issues that prevent hardware from being successfully onboarded into Oracle data centers. Acting as a technical point of contact for operational support, the role partners with Oracle's global manufacturing partners, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and cross\-functional engineering teams to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and drive timely resolution of critical operational incidents. The successful candidate will manage technical investigations, recommend corrective actions, and identify opportunities for systemic improvement. Responsibility for implementing product or process changes will transition to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams once investigation and recommendations are complete. This role supports a global operational environment and participates in a follow\-the\-sun support model, including scheduled weekend and after\-hours coverage as required. **Technical Support \& Investigation** * Investigate and resolve complex product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Monitor, prioritize, and respond to technical support tickets within the operational support queue. * Perform technical triage to identify root causes and determine appropriate resolution paths. * Collaborate with Oracle's global manufacturing partners to investigate and resolve product\-data quality issues while ensuring corrective actions are measurable, verified, and minimize future recurrence. * Monitor daily manufacturing data feeds to identify data\-quality issues and operational exceptions requiring investigation. * Perform detailed root cause analysis, including writing SQL queries to examine raw database records and investigate non\-standard technical issues. * Read and interpret XML and JSON data to identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or improperly formatted product information. * Utilize REST services to retrieve, validate, and submit product data where required. Use Python, where appropriate, to analyze, transform, or validate data supporting technical investigations. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to coordinate technical investigations. * Recommend corrective actions that address underlying system or process issues rather than individual incidents alone. * Initiate and coordinate recommendations for systemic improvements while transitioning implementation ownership to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams. * Where investigations require work at remote manufacturing or data centre locations, coordinate appropriate handoff to the responsible Product Engineer or operational team. Track investigations, recommendations, and follow\-up activities through completion to ensure timely resolution. * **Operational Excellence** * Prioritize technical issues based on business impact, operational urgency, and data center onboarding risk. * Effectively manage competing priorities within a fast\-paced operational support environment. * Produce clear investigation reports, root cause analyses, and technical documentation. * Develop and contribute to operational knowledge articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support best practices. * Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, workflows, and data quality based on investigation outcomes. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership. * **Required Skills and Experience** **Technical Skills** * Strong analytical, investigative, and root cause analysis skills. * Experience writing SQL queries for technical investigation and data analysis. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting. * Ability to read and interpret XML and JSON. * Experience working with REST APIs and related data sources. * Basic Python programming skills for data analysis and automation. * Understanding of data validation and product\-data quality principles. * Familiarity with server and rack\-level hardware, configuration, and topology. Understanding of Product Bills of Materials (BOMs) and parent\-child component relationships. * **Professional Skills** * Ability to coordinate technical investigations across multiple teams and geographic regions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Confidence communicating with both technical teams and senior leadership. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Ability to perform effectively under pressure while managing multiple concurrent investigations. * Experience identifying and recommending systemic improvements that reduce recurring operational issues. Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed cross\-functional teams. * **Measures of Success** Success in this role will be demonstrated through: * Reduction in product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Faster investigation and resolution of critical operational incidents. * Reduced recurrence of issues through effective root cause analysis and recommended corrective actions. * Improved product\-data quality across Oracle's manufacturing partner network. * Earlier identification and resolution of data\-quality issues before products reach Oracle data centers. * Effective collaboration and communication across Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other global teams. * High\-quality technical documentation and knowledge sharing that improves operational efficiency. Consistent delivery of technical support within a global 24x7 operational environment. * **Location** : Nashville, TN

jobs.description: Remote, California, United States of America Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-020844 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. **Job Summary** As the Manager of Managed XSIAM (MSIAM) SOC Engineering, you will lead, mentor, and grow a team of high\-performing SOC and Detection Engineers. This is a dynamic, "player\-coach" role that balances strategic people leadership with active technical contribution. You will drive engineering execution, steer technical strategy and playbook architecture, and jump into code alongside your team when needed. Operating at the intersection of product, engineering, and threat intelligence, you will collaborate closely with Cortex Engineering and internal Unit 42 teams to elevate detection efficacy, optimize automations, and maintain flawless operational execution. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead \& Empower: Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of SOC and Detection Engineers, driving career development, team retention, and operational excellence. * Hands\-On Technical Leadership: Remain actively involved in the engineering cycle—evaluating technical architectures, writing code (Python), designing complex automation playbooks, and ensuring overall technical quality. * Content Innovation \& Roadmap Expansion: Spearhead research into emerging threat landscapes, platform capabilities, and security frameworks to identify, scope, and prioritize new content packs, integrations, and automation initiatives for the team to develop. * Engineering \& Delivery Execution: Own end\-to\-end detection and playbook development workflows, maintaining accountability for team KPIs including SLA adherence, detection quality, deployment speed, and customer satisfaction. * Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with internal Unit 42 research teams and Cortex Engineering to translate emerging threat research into production\-ready XSIAM capabilities and platform improvements. * Quality Assurance \& Standards: Enforce rigorous development standards across the team for staging, testing, soft implementation, and continuous tuning to maximize operational performance. * Customer Escalation Support: Serve as a senior technical escalation point, stepping in on high\-priority client engagements and architecture reviews when required. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Management Experience: 3\+ years of experience directly managing security engineering or SOC teams in an enterprise or managed services environment. * Total Industry Experience: 5\+ years of comprehensive experience across Detection Engineering, SIEM, SOAR, and EDR/XDR platforms, serving as a technical authority on SecOps infrastructure and long\-term automation strategy. * Advanced Engineering Rigor: Strong hands\-on coding proficiency (e.g., Python) with practical experience implementing modern engineering standards, such as Detection\-as\-Code (DaC), CI/CD pipelines for playbook deployment, and rigorous software development lifecycles within a SOC. * Deep Threat \& Domain Expertise: Profound understanding of APT attack lifecycles (e.g., initial access, lateral movement, data exfiltration, persistence mechanisms) and the ability to design advanced correlation logic and automated workflows to counter highly sophisticated threat actors. * Operational Mindset: Track record of driving engineering execution against defined SLAs and quality metrics while maintaining high team performance. * Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional collaborative skills with the proven ability to seamlessly bridge deep technical engineering concepts with executive, client\-facing, and cross\-functional communication. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * AI in SecOps \& Automation: Practical experience leveraging AI, LLMs, or Machine Learning to enhance threat detection, streamline playbook generation, or drive efficiency in SOC workflows. * Incident Response Background: Prior hands\-on experience in Incident Response (IR) or Threat Hunting. * Platform Expertise: Direct experience with Cortex XSIAM or Cortex XSOAR platforms. * Threat Frameworks: Practical experience utilizing frameworks like MITRE ATT\&CK to drive coverage mapping and detection gap analyses. jobs.title: AI Engineer – Robotics Data Preprocessing
jobs.description: **Job Title:** AI Engineer – Robotics Data Preprocessing **Department:** Software **Reports To:** Teleoperations Lead **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Location:** Houston, TX or Pensacola FL **Who We Are** Persona AI is building humanoid robots for the most demanding environments in heavy industry — shipyards, steel mills, fabrication facilities, and offshore platforms — performing welding, grinding, maintenance, inspection, and material\-handling work that is dangerous, physically demanding, and increasingly difficult to staff. We are backed by leading strategic and financial investors and engaged with global industrial leaders across Korea, Japan, the United States, and Singapore. Korea is the center of gravity for our early commercial strategy, anchored by relationships with the world’s leading shipbuilders and steelmakers. Our work spans both the robot platform itself and the systems, partners, and playbooks required to deploy it at scale. **Why Join Persona AI?** * We offer competitive compensation, a performance\-based bonus, 99% employer covered medical benefits, early\-stage equity, competitive PTO, and a company\-wide paid winter break between December 24th and January 2nd. * You’ll shape technology that’s redefining the possibilities of robotics and human interaction. * Work alongside passionate teammates who value creativity, and continuous learning. * Enjoy full access to advanced tools, **About the Role** At Persona we require an unprecedented volume of high\-quality, multimodal data. We are moving beyond basic teleoperation to leverage massive datasets of in\-the\-wild egocentric video combined with dense sensor streams (IMU, haptics, kinematics, and high\-fidelity force profiles). We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer to architect the systems that turn this raw, unstructured multimodal data into high\-fidelity training assets for our robots. Models are only as good as the data they learn from. In humanoid robotics, that's not a platitude, it's the bottleneck. There's no Internet\-scale corpus of robots manipulating the physical world. We have to create it. That's this role. As an AI Data Engineer, you sit at the most leveraged point in our entire training pipeline: every model we ship is downstream of the data you build. If this role succeeds, our foundation models learn dexterity faster than anyone else's. If it fails, nothing else matters. You will architect and scale the infrastructure that turns raw, messy reality into training\-grade data, extracting, augmenting, and aligning human dexterous manipulation data from massive multi\-sensor and egocentric video datasets. You'll build advanced pre\-processing algorithms that recover what sensors can't directly see: quantifying grasp dynamics from force\-torque signals, estimating contact forces from visual cues alone, reconstructing heavily occluded hand poses, and lifting 3D geometry out of 2D frames. And because every minute of teleoperation data is expensive, you'll make each one count: using spatial, temporal, and cross\-modal augmentation to multiply the value of everything our collection team captures. Your work directly determines how fast our models learn and how far they can go. **What You Will Be Doing** * **Force Analysis \& Hidden State Inference:** Design cross\-modal validation systems that verify video, proprioception, force/haptic signals, and language annotations agree with each other, e.g., reprojecting robot state into the image plane to confirm video–state consistency, and VLM\-assisted checks that instructions match observed behavior. * **Kinematic Retargeting \& Alignment:** orchestrating hand\-tracking, segmentation, depth estimation, 3D reconstruction, and pose\-tracking modules; retargeting human demonstrations into robot trajectories; and running simulation\-in\-the\-loop validation (kinematic feasibility, physics replay, motion\-consistency filtering) so synthesized data is physically grounded, not just visually plausible. * **Advanced Data Augmentation:** Implement robust data augmentation strategies (spatial transformations, temporal scaling, synthetic viewpoints, and sensor noise injection) to expand expert trajectories and improve the robustness of our learning models. * **Teleoperation Synchronization:** unified state–action representations across differing embodiments, coordinate frames, rotation conventions, gripper/hand parameterizations, and sampling rates, with per\-dimension validity masking and per\-source normalization so that adding a new robot or sensor is a configuration change, not a rewrite. * **Close the loop with data consumers**: build the tooling that lets researchers query, visualize, and audit datasets (clip browsers, trajectory viewers, annotation review UIs), and turn model\-failure analyses into new curation rules and targeted re\-collection requests. * **Multimodal Data Pipelines:** Architect end\-to\-end ingestion pipelines that take raw, unstructured recordings (egocentric video, teleoperation sessions, third\-party open datasets) and produce indexed, queryable, training\-ready datasets. This includes temporal segmentation of long recordings into action clips, metadata and scene\-graph extraction, embedding\-based retrieval, and language annotation workflows. **What We Are Looking For** * **Education:** M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field. * **Programming \& ML Frameworks:** Deep expertise in Python and extensive experience with PyTorch, specifically in handling custom dataloaders for multimodal datasets. * **Force \& Time\-Series Data Processing:** Experience analyzing and processing complex time\-series data from force\-torque (F/T) sensors, load cells, or tactile arrays, ensuring pristine alignment with visual frames. * **Video Processing Expertise:** Mastery of video processing pipelines and libraries (OpenCV, FFmpeg, Decord) and managing the I/O bottlenecks of terabyte\-scale video datasets. * **Solid working knowledge of 3D geometry and robotics data:** coordinate frames and transforms, rotation representations, camera intrinsics/extrinsics, forward/inverse kinematics, URDF. * **Data Augmentation:** Proven ability to implement programmatic and generative data augmentation techniques for computer vision and time\-series data. **Bonus Skills** * Experience with NVIDIA’s robotic software stack (Open X\-Embodiment, DROID, AgiBot World, EgoDex, or similar). * Familiarity with the modern perception toolbox as a user: segmentation (SAM\-family), monocular depth, hand/body pose estimation (MANO/SMPL), 6\-DoF object pose tracking, point tracking—you don't need to train these models, but you should be comfortable composing and evaluating them in a pipeline * Familiarity with distributed data processing systems (Ray, Apache Spark) for cluster computing. * Background in generating or utilizing synthetic robotic data via simulation (Omniverse, MuJoCo). * Experience integrating spatial awareness or tactile data representations (e.g., Fourier encoding) into visual pipelines. ***Persona AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** ***All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.***
