jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Ads
jobs.description: **Opportunity:** Offerwall by Unity is a leading mobile advertising and monetization platform that empowers game developers to maximize revenue and engage users through rewarded experiences. For over a decade, we've connected millions of players with offers that provide tangible in\-app value, and we're now building the next generation of that product. At the center of it is Offer Delivery, the backend service that decides which offer a player sees, when, and on what terms. It operates on two fronts: bidding in real time into video ad auctions as a DSP, and placing offers directly outside the auction flow. Both are high\-throughput, latency\-sensitive, and revenue\-critical. We're seeking a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical leader for Offer Delivery. You will set the technical vision for the service, define its architecture, influence its roadmap, and drive delivery of it. You'll own how targeting, pacing, and supply\-side rules are expressed and enforced on the serving path. You'll coordinate closely with the auction, machine learning, platform, and product teams whose systems Offer Delivery sits between. As a technical leader on our Offerwall team, you will play a critical role in evolving our core monetization product, designing and implementing its next generation of technology. This is an exciting opportunity to lead impactful initiatives, architect robust solutions, and directly contribute to the financial success of countless mobile app developers and the engagement of millions of users globally. You will work at the intersection of rewarded advertising, advanced fraud prevention, and large\-scale data processing, driving innovation that directly impacts our bottom line and industry leadership. Your solutions will foster stronger collaboration and integration with other Ads products at Unity. You will mentor and guide engineers as they design, build, and deploy web applications and services. You will also play a key role in designing backend technical solutions that focus on system performance, reliability, and delivering business value at scale. **What you'll be doing:** * Architect \& Design: Lead the technical design and architecture for Offer Delivery services, features, and critical strategic initiatives, collaborating closely with senior engineers and managers. * Develop \& Innovate: Build, test, and operate the Golang services that power real\-time bidding into video auctions (OpenRTB) and direct offer placement outside the auction flow. * Raise the Bar: Mentor engineers, set engineering standards, and foster a culture of technical excellence on the team. * Drive Cross\-team Delivery: Ensure seamless communication and collaboration with product, Ad Viewer, teams in a distributed environment. * Operate \& Maintain: Ensure the high availability and reliability of our production services, including participation in on\-call rotations and proactive system monitoring. **What we're looking for:** * Technical Leadership: track record of owning a significant backend system, setting direction, making the architectural calls, and getting it delivered through others as well as yourself. * High\-scale distributed systems: Demonstrated ability to design and ship large\-scale, highly available, latency\-sensitive distributed services with complex business logic. * Core Technologies: Strong proficiency in backend development using Go (or clear ability to become effective in it quickly). Working knowledge of gRPC with a willingness to adapt to the best tool for the job. * Observability \& Data Streaming: Practical experience with observability platforms (logging, metrics, monitoring/tracing) and message bus technologies for managing complex data streams. * Integration Design: track record of building new systems amid rapidly shifting requirements. You can design systems that are stable through three requirement changes, and you know which change should revise the core data flow. * Cross\-team influence \& mentorship: Experience driving technical work across team boundaries and developing the engineers around you. **Strongly preferred:** * Experience building or operating a DSP, ad exchange, or real\-time bidding system, and familiarity with OpenRTB. * Working understanding of supply\-side ad mediation concepts such as waterfall vs. bidding, adapter and SDK integration, and how creative\-format choices determine which mediators and networks can carry your demand. * Background in ad serving, auction mechanics, or programmatic advertising more generally. **Additional information:** Zone A: $200,400 \- $260,500 Zone B: $178,300 \- $231,800 Zone C: $157,800 \- $205,200 This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. jobs.title: Assistant Professor (TT) - Mechanical and Industrial Engineering - Aerospace
jobs.description: * 509840 * Amherst, Massachusetts, United States * Academic Year (9 Months) * Full Time * MSP * On Site * Riccio College of Engineering * Tenure Track * Faculty * Opening on: Sep 8 2026 **Executive Area:** Academic Affairs **College/School/MBU:** Engineering **Department:** Mech \& Industrial Engineering **Work Location:** Amherst **Schedule:** Full Time **Work Arrangement:** Onsite **Job Summary** The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering at the University of Massachusetts Amherst is seeking talented applicants qualified for a tenure\-track assistant professor position in aerospace engineering. Under exceptional circumstances, highly qualified candidates at other ranks may receive consideration. The appointment is expected to begin September 1, 2027\. The Department is committed to building a vibrant and inclusive academic community that reflects and advances the university’s strategic priorities. The position is defined broadly across aerospace engineering, and scholars working across disciplines are encouraged. Specific areas of interest include, but are not limited to: propulsion, thermal management, and electrified/hybrid\-electric propulsion; AI\-augmented design (generative, learning) of aerospace structures or systems; robotics/controls, including nonlinear and multi\-agent systems. We are committed to expanding beyond our traditional strengths, and we especially welcome candidates whose work builds bridges to regional industry and to our existing strengths in thermo\-fluids, materials, advanced manufacturing, robotics, and remote sensing. As a campus, college, and department with an increasingly diverse student body, we are looking for candidates who can operate effectively in a diverse faculty and student community, and who value collegiality, collaboration, achievement, and integrity. We encourage applications from individuals with a commitment to mentor under\-represented demographics within engineering. We welcome candidates who have had non\-traditional career paths, those who have paused their careers for family or other reasons, or who spent time outside of academia. **Essential Functions** The candidate is expected to develop an externally\-funded research program in aerospace engineering, and develop and maintain an internationally recognized scholarly presence. The candidate is expected to contribute to teaching existing graduate and undergraduate courses in aerospace and mechanical engineering, for example, aerodynamics, propulsion, flight dynamics and controls, or aerospace thermal systems, and will be encouraged to develop creative new curricula, including courses supporting the department's aerospace academic program. The candidate is also expected to contribute meaningful service to their department, College, University and externally within their field through participation in committees, faculty governance, and activities that support the academic community. **Other Functions** Other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications** Applicants must have a Ph.D. in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, or anticipate such a degree by September 1, 2027\. **Additional Details** The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering has 38 full\-time, tenure\-track faculty members and approximately 140 graduate students and 830 undergraduates. The department's FY25 research expenditures exceeded $9\.5 million. Additional information about the department can be obtained at https://www.umass.edu/engineering/mechanical\-and\-industrial\-engineering. The Daniel J. Riccio Jr. College of Engineering is recognized as one of the top 35 public engineering schools in the nation by *U.S. News \& World Report* and is the \#1 public engineering program in New England. Our inclusive and dynamic community includes \~2700 undergraduate, \~650 graduate students and \~160 instructional faculty (full\-time tenure stream and lecturers) across five engineering departments—biomedical, chemical and biomolecular, civil and environmental, electrical and computer, and mechanical and industrial. Our faculty members are developing life\-saving medical devices and therapeutics; revolutionizing next\-generation manufacturing and materials; advancing AI, robotics and autonomous systems; designing smart infrastructures; tackling climate change; and leading breakthroughs in computing and cybersecurity. They are recipients of prestigious national recognitions, including 22 CAREER Awards since 2020\. With over $69 million in research expenditures and 20\+ affiliated research centers and programs, we're at the forefront of discovery. Our faculty and students engage actively in innovation, transforming ideas into meaningful impact through entrepreneurship activities, patenting new discoveries, and new venture creation. Our new Sustainable Engineering Laboratories building offers immersive labs and learning spaces, enabling us to test and develop technologies that address rea ed on established, disciplinary\-specific faculty compensation surveys. The specific pay for this position will be determined by the University based on consideration of all relevant factors, including faculty rank and required or relevant factors, including faculty rank and required or relevant certifications, when and if it decides to extend an offer of employment. **Special Instructions for Applicants** Candidates must provide the following in their application package addressed to the "Aerospace Engineering Search Committee." Applications will be reviewed starting on November 1, 2026, and reviewed until the search is completed. All files must be provided in .pdf format. Applicants must disclose whether and to what extent AI tools were used in the preparation of their application package. A cover letter, addressed to the "Aerospace Engineering Search Committee." The cover letter should (a) introduce yourself and (b) briefly describe your interest in and alignment with this position and the mission and vision of the Riccio College of Engineering. **Page limit: 1 page.** An overall vision statement. Candidates should describe the overall vision of what they would like to accomplish in their career, integrating across all aspects of teaching, research, outreach, and service, and discuss the inspiration that will sustain them in this faculty position. **Page limit: 2 pages.** A research statement. Candidates should situate their past research in a broader scholarly context and give their research vision for this position. Candidates are specifically asked to mention the types of scholarship they will perform, how that scholarship will be disseminated, expectations for how that scholarship will be funded, collaboration potential, and any connections to community engagement, broadening participation in STEM, or grand challenges in engineering. **Page limit: 2 pages.** A teaching and mentoring statement. Candidates should address teaching and mentoring of graduate and undergraduate students, as well as recruiting of graduate students. Candidates should describe their past teaching and mentoring experience and express their vision for educating the next generation of engineers. Candidates are specifically asked to mention existing courses in aerospace and mechanical engineering they are qualified to offer, and courses they are interested in developing (including courses that could support the department's aerospace academic program). Please discuss any plans for making engineering engaging to all students. **Page limit: 2 pages.** A current curriculum vitae. The CV is typically ordered as follows: (1\) education, (2\) employment, (3\) awards and honors, (4\) sponsored research (if any), (5\) peer\-reviewed publications, (6\) service, (7\) teaching experience, and (8\) other sections as considered appropriate by the candidate. Contact information (name, title, email address, institution) for 3 professional references. At least one reference should be from a current or former supervisor. Reference letters will be requested after the short list is approved (see Process below). The steps of the process are as follows: A minimally qualified pool is identified from the applicants, ideally by the middle of November, 2026\. All remaining candidates are evaluated and a "long list" is identified, which will be interviewed via video conference. Candidates invited to these interviews will be emailed at least one week before the scheduled date. A "short list" is developed from the long list, and these candidates will be invited to interview on campus. For candidates advancing to the short\-list (on\-campus interview) stage: references will be contacted. On\-campus interviews are anticipated in February, 2027\. *This position will remain open for the time period required by any applicable collective bargaining agreement and will continue until a suitable candidate pool is identified. Interested applicants are strongly encouraged to apply early.*

jobs.title: Senior Partner Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: VAST Data is looking to hire a Senior Partner Solutions Engineer– OEM / eBox to join our growing team! VAST Data is defining an entirely new category in enterprise infrastructure by building the world’s first Operating System for AI. As VAST expands the ways customers deploy the VAST AI OS, we are looking for a deeply technical Partner Solutions Engineer to serve as a subject matter expert for VAST deployments on partner and customer\-selected hardware, with a primary focus on the VAST EBox platform. This role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, field engineering, product expertise and strategic customer engagement. You will become one of VAST’s foremost experts on how the VAST AI OS performs, scales and operates across partner hardware platforms—and a trusted technical resource for VAST Sales Engineers, partners and customers. **The Role:** The Senior Partner Solutions Engineer will own the technical strategy and field success of VAST’s partner\-based deployment model. You will help customers understand not simply how to deploy VAST on partner hardware, but how to get the most from the platform: how to size it, what performance to expect, how hardware and configuration choices affect the customer experience, and where customization can unlock additional value for strategic deployments. You will support VAST Sales Engineers and partner technical teams throughout the sales cycle, acting as the technical authority for EBox\-based solutions. For broadly repeatable deployments, you will provide architecture, guidance and best practices. For VAST’s most strategic opportunities, you will take a much more active role—helping design the solution, recommending customizations, validating readiness and taking accountability for a successful deployment. Success in this role means making VAST on partner hardware a predictable, high\-performance and differentiated customer experience. **What You’ll Do:** Serve as VAST’s technical subject matter expert for EBox and other partner\-based deployment models. Act as an escalation point and trusted advisor for VAST Sales Engineers designing solutions on partner hardware. Participate in strategic customer campaigns that demonstrate the technical and economic value of deploying the VAST AI OS on partner platforms. Size and architect solutions based on customer workloads, performance objectives, capacity requirements and infrastructure constraints. Develop clear expectations for performance, scalability, resiliency and operational experience across supported hardware configurations. Understand how server, networking, storage media, and configuration choices affect VAST performance and customer experience. Recommend and help validate platform customizations for highly strategic opportunities, including understanding the downstream impact of those changes on performance, supportability, lifecycle management and operations. Guide customers and partners through pre\-installation readiness, infrastructure validation and deployment planning. Develop custom installation and success plans for complex or strategic deployments. Lead or coordinate troubleshooting of challenging deployment issues spanning hardware, networking, configuration and VAST software. Partner closely with Support, Engineering and Product to resolve field issues and translate deployment experience into product and process improvements. Build repeatable architectures, deployment practices, sizing methodologies and technical guidance that enable the broader SE and partner ecosystem to operate independently. Support VAST Amplify and other software\-defined deployment models that extend the VAST AI OS across customer\-selected infrastructure. ﻿ **Requirements:** Exceptional technical depth across enterprise infrastructure, with the ability to understand how hardware, networking and distributed software interact as a complete system. Deep hands\-on experience deploying, tuning and troubleshooting complex infrastructure in production data centers. Strong knowledge of enterprise storage, distributed systems, software\-defined infrastructure and server architecture. Strong networking expertise, including the ability to diagnose connectivity, configuration, topology and performance issues. Ability to translate workload requirements into infrastructure sizing, architecture and realistic performance expectations. Experience evaluating the impact of hardware or configuration changes on system performance, reliability and operational behavior. Strong troubleshooting instincts and the ability to isolate complex problems across hardware, networking, firmware and software layers. The credibility and communication skills to serve as a technical authority for experienced Sales Engineers, customers and partner engineering teams. Comfortable moving between strategic architecture discussions and hands\-on technical problem solving. Background in sales engineering, field engineering, professional services, implementation, support engineering or a similar customer\-facing technical role. Experience with OEM server platforms and/or enterprise storage technologies is highly desirable. Ability to travel to strategic customer and partner locations across the United States as required. **Ideal Background:** The ideal candidate combines the technical depth of a senior field, services or support engineer with the architecture skills and customer presence of an experienced Sales Engineer. Strong candidates may come from enterprise infrastructure, storage, networking or software\-defined systems companies. More important than any specific company background is the ability to become a true platform expert: someone who understands how the solution behaves in the real world, can guide other technical teams with confidence, and can take ownership when a strategic customer deployment needs to succeed.

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Veedma is a telehealth practice for men's hormonal and sexual health. We treat low testosterone, erectile dysfunction, and the symptoms men actually feel: libido, erection, energy, strength, and mood, in men 18 and up, fully online. Most low testosterone is secondary and reversible, so we find the cause first and stimulate the body's own production before resorting to TRT. Enclomiphene is the foundation; Tadalafil is co\-prescribed when erectile or prostate symptoms coexist with low Free Testosterone. Testosterone replacement therapy is not a service we currently offer.** The platform is AI\-native by default. Both founders code in Claude Code every day. Production code calls OpenAI's API from Python for the in\-product features and content pipeline. Akute is the EHR, Stripe handles billing. About the founders You will work with both of us directly, every day. The CTO is the one reviewing your code. Vladimir Kotlov, MD \- Founder \& CEO. Urologist by training (MD, 2014\) with clinical experience in men's reproductive health. The clinical voice in every product call. (https://www.linkedin.com/in/vkotlov/) Victor Kuznetsov \- Founder \& CTO. 20\+ years in software engineering and AI/ML. Previously Co\-Founder \& CTO of Yva.ai (people analytics, acquired by Visier). Owns the Veedma platform end\-to\-end today and will review your code. (https://www.linkedin.com/in/wiltodelta/) If the people you would be reporting to matters to you (it should), open both profiles before you apply. You probably fit if When you see a bug, a slow query, a missing tool \- your hand is already on the keyboard. You don't wait for a ticket, a sprint, a spec review. You read the code, fix the thing, write the migration, and the PR is in flight before lunch. You're personally interested in men's health, hormone optimization, or longevity \- the engineers who do their best work here are the ones who would use the product themselves. You don't need to be a Veedma patient, but you should be the kind of person who would consider becoming one. What you will own \- Patient\-facing flows. Intake, lab upload, report delivery, messaging, payment. \- Internal tools for the clinical team. Whatever turns the platform into a clinic \- lists of who needs what next, draft\-and\-send workflows, the small admin screens that save the team a day a week. \- Integrations. Akute, Stripe, Postmark, Fillout, ShipStation, Slack. \- Spec to prod, end\-to\-end. Spec Monday, in production by midweek, watched in Sentry the same day. No handoffs. \- The AI layer, both sides of it. Inside the product and the content pipeline: OpenAI API calls from Python that power the features and automations that benefit from an LLM. Inside the team: Claude Code skills and sub\-agents the founders and clinician use to do their own work faster. You own and extend both. Stack \- Python (Flask) primary. Backend, async jobs, integrations, data pipelines, internal tools. \- PostgreSQL \- Celery \+ Redis for queues and scheduled jobs \- Tailwind CSS \+ Flowbite , server\-rendered from Flask templates. No SPA today. \- Akute (EHR), Stripe, Postmark, Fillout, ShipStation, Slack as the live integrations. \- OpenAI API called from Python for the in\-product features and content\-pipeline automations that benefit from an LLM. Choice of model is not religion either \- we will switch providers when the trade\-off changes. \- Claude Code, custom skills, and MCP integrations are how the team works day\-to\-day. This is the stack today, not a religion. We swap pieces when there is a real reason. We expect you to argue for changes, lead them, and own the cost of them. The wrong fit is "I only work with X" in either direction. What we are looking for \- 10\+ years building production web apps end\-to\-end. Senior, hands\-on. You have shipped features real customers used and paid for, and you have owned a system long enough to live with your own design decisions. \- Healthcare is in your background. Most of those years were spent shipping production code at a healthcare, telehealth, EHR, digital therapeutics, pharmacy, or medical\-device company. You know what PHI is. You have argued about HIPAA with a security team. You have hit an EHR API and lived to tell about it. \- You want to stay in healthcare. This is not your "let me try something different from fintech" tour. When you describe what you want to build over the next 5 years, healthcare is in the answer without prompting. \- Claude Code is your primary tool. Not Cursor, not Copilot autocompletes, not "I sometimes ask Claude". 6\+ months of daily use, 4\+ hours per day. You write skills, wire up MCP servers, compose sub\-agents, and have a real CLAUDE.md in every repo you own. If you cannot describe your Claude Code workflow in concrete detail, wrong seat. \- Strong Python. This is our primary language. Production Python at depth \- typed code, async, packaging, profiling, real test coverage on the parts that matter. Not "I picked it up for a side project." \- Ship across the stack daily. Frontend, backend, schema migrations, infra \- whichever the task needs. You don't wait for a teammate to do the other half. \- Real external integrations under your belt. At least one that mattered \- payments, EHR, messaging, identity. You know what good error handling looks like, and what 3am pager pain teaches you. \- You have shipped LLM features to real users, not demos. Production prompt engineering, evals on real data, retrieval, structured outputs, cost\-and\-latency budgeting \- you know what each of these is and why each one bites. "I have used ChatGPT" does not count. "I built a cool demo" does not count. \- Tooling is part of your job. If the internal dashboard you need doesn't exist, you build it. If the deploy is painful, you fix it. If the test suite is slow, you make it fast. You don't file tickets against yourself. \- Tests on the parts that need them, not everywhere. Nice to have \- Direct experience with EHR systems (Akute, Healthie). \- Worked at Hims, Ro, Hone, Maximus, or similar DTC telehealth. \- Stripe billing experience beyond a basic checkout. \- Flask, Peewee, or Celery in production. \- Comfortable shipping server\-rendered HTML (Jinja templates, Tailwind) when that's what the task needs \- and equally comfortable arguing for a SPA, a different framework, or a different language when it earns its keep. How we operate \- AI\-native, not AI\-curious. Both founders code in Claude Code every day. The bar for "should this be a tool" is hours, not weeks. In\-product LLM features (OpenAI API in Python) and team\-side AI tooling (Claude Code skills) are both real, both maintained, and both yours to extend. \- No queues, no tickets pointed at yourself. If you see it broken, you fix it. If a script would save you four hours a week, you build it Friday. We don't wait. \- Never idle. Always something being tested, a signal we're chasing, a part of the product getting tighter. A week without something new shipped to patients or providers is a broken week. \- Signals over opinions. What patients message us, what support tickets say, where the funnel breaks, what the error logs scream \- that sets the backlog. The product changes when the data says so, fast. \- Straight line to the founders. No layers. You're in the room (Slack, Linear, the weekly call) where product, clinical, and business decisions happen. You're expected to push back when you disagree. \- Business\-engaged or wrong seat. Not someone who picks up tickets and goes home. Someone who reads retention, has a view on what should be built next, and pings us at 9pm when production is off. \- Async\-first, US hours overlap. Code review by the team. No long\-running branches. We ship every day at minimum. Compensation $160,000\-$200,000 per year plus 1\.0%\-1\.25% equity. Full\-time, remote within the United States. Veedma does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI, Sensor Fusion & Precision Phenotyping Intern
jobs.description: **Join Vylor—Powering the Future of Agriculture** At Vylor, we’re advancing agriculture through breakthrough science—combining elite germplasm, cutting\-edge biotech, and next\-generation expertise in gene editing and molecular breeding. Our portfolio includes trusted industry brands like Pioneer®, Brevant®, and Hoegemeyer®, delivering performance farmers rely on. Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science. Vylor is seeking an **AI, Sensor Fusion \& Precision Phenotyping Intern** for a 3\-month research internship starting Summer 2027\. You will join our Artificial Intelligence \& Breeding group and help develop field\-deployed perception systems that turn raw sensor data into quantitative plant measurements at scale. The work spans computer vision, 3D computational geometry, LiDAR and multi\-modal sensor fusion, and machine learning, applied to data collected by ground robotic platforms in real breeding environments. Expect meaningful ownership of an R\&D project from problem framing through algorithm development, field validation, and technical communication. **Key Responsibilities** * Extract quantitative plant traits from multi\-modal field imagery—RGB, LiDAR, multispectral, hyperspectral, thermal, and IMU/GNSS—using 3D computational geometry and sensor\-fusion techniques. * Implement and execute repeatable, well\-documented workflows that apply established computer vision and machine learning methods with sensor\-fusion\-driven pre\- and post\-processing, delivered as modular components and scalable pipelines. * Own a scientific research project with direct plant breeding impact: design experiments, quantify accuracy and failure modes, collaborate with breeders, geneticists, and engineers, and communicate results to technical and business audiences. **Qualifications** * Currently pursuing an MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Agricultural/Biosystems Engineering, or a related field; PhD candidates preferred. * Enrolled at an accredited university during the internship; minimum 3\.0 GPA preferred. * Solid foundation in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, or computational phenotyping, with working knowledge of 3D computational geometry (point cloud processing, coordinate transforms, calibration and registration, and geometric feature analysis). * Strong Python programming and hands\-on experience with modern machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). * Software engineering fundamentals: clean API and framework design, modular code, version control (Git), and disciplined testing. * Hands\-on experience with LiDAR point cloud processing, 3D reconstruction, camera/LiDAR calibration, or multi\-sensor fusion. * Strong analytical, experimental, and problem\-solving skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building perception systems for outdoor, unstructured environments (agriculture, autonomous vehicles, field robotics, construction, or mining). * Background in plant breeding, computational plant phenotyping, crop science, or agricultural robotics. * Experience integrating multispectral, hyperspectral, or thermal imaging with RGB and/or LiDAR data. * Familiarity with Open3D, PCL, ROS/ROS 2, COLMAP, OpenCV, PyTorch3D, CloudCompare, Helios, or similar 3D and perception toolchains. * Experience with AWS or MLOps for large\-scale machine learning pipelines, or with sensor calibration and synthetic data / simulation (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, Blender, Unreal). * Research publications, open\-source contributions, patents, or demonstrated real\-world technical projects. **What We Value** We are looking for someone who is self\-motivated, technically curious, hands\-on, and accountable—comfortable operating independently in an ambiguous R\&D environment, quickly learning new technologies and problem domains, and taking ownership of delivering meaningful technical outcomes. Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team. ### ***Corteva announced to separate our current advanced seed and genetics business to establish a standalone company, operating as Vylor, Inc. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to legal requirements and board approval. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the separation, you would be an employee of Vylor, Inc. and your employment would be governed by Vylor, Inc. employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by Vylor, Inc. at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.*** ### **Vylor is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, military or veteran status, pregnancy related conditions (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), disability or any other protected status in accordance with federal, state, or local laws.**

jobs.title: Manager, Media Engineering
jobs.description: ***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.*** **Who We Are…** When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next… From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive. **Your New Role:** We are seeking a Media Engineering Manager to lead the technical evolution of **Keystone**, an internal production technology platform that serves as the front door to the content supply chain. Keystone supports productions from initial intake through final asset delivery, connecting production teams, vendors, QC, localization, media operations, and internal distribution systems. This role sits at the intersection of media engineering, software development, post\-production operations, and platform delivery. The Media Engineering Manager will be responsible for leading a development team, designing scalable media workflow solutions, supporting intersystem integrations, and ensuring Keystone continues to meet the needs of a growing portfolio of shows, users, vendors, and operational workflows. This role requires a hybrid skill set: deep AV media engineering expertise, traditional hands\-on\-keyboard software development capability, and the ability to lead engineers in a complex, business\-critical production environment. This is not a traditional enterprise application role. Keystone is a complex, operationally critical platform used daily by internal and external teams working under tight production schedules, high asset volume, and strict delivery requirements. **Responsibilities:** **Engineering Leadership \& Team Management** * Lead, mentor, and manage a team of software engineers, media engineers, and technical contributors supporting Keystone * Provide technical direction across platform architecture, workflow automation, integrations, and media pipeline execution * Balance hands\-on engineering contribution with people leadership, delivery management, and technical oversight * Partner with product, operations, and architecture leadership to translate business and workflow needs into scalable technical solutions * Establish engineering standards, development practices, documentation expectations, and delivery discipline across the Keystone team **Media Workflow \& Platform Expertise** * Develop and maintain a deep understanding of end\-to\-end production, post\-production, and distribution pipelines * Design multi\-functional media workflows involving data I/O, transcode, QC, localization, metadata enrichment, packaging, and final delivery * Identify workflow gaps, technical bottlenecks, and manual workarounds that can be improved through automation, integration, or platform enhancement * Bring practical media engineering judgment to decisions involving file formats, metadata, essence, package structures, and downstream delivery requirements **Systems, Integrations \& Automation** * Lead technical integration efforts across AWS, SDVI Rally, MAM systems, internal media platforms, vendor systems, QC tools, transcode services, localization workflows, and delivery endpoints * Design and support intersystem integrations using APIs, event\-driven workflows, scripting, data mapping, and middleware patterns * Partner with architecture and infrastructure teams to ensure Keystone integrates reliably with broader enterprise systems * Troubleshoot complex issues across connected systems, including failed jobs, missing metadata, file movement errors, transcode failures, QC exceptions, and delivery blockers * Improve workflow observability through logging, monitoring, status tracking, reporting, and operational dashboards **Hands\-On Engineering \& Delivery** * Contribute directly to technical design, code review, scripting, integration logic, and platform development as needed * Help decompose complex technical and operational needs into actionable engineering work * Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, solution design, release planning, and production deployment activities * Ensure engineering work is delivered with appropriate quality, scalability, security, and operational supportability * Drive continuous improvement across development practices, technical documentation, platform reliability, and release execution **Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Serve as the primary technical bridge between: * Keystone engineering team and chief architect * Product management and engineering teams * Media operations, QC, localization, and delivery teams * Vendors and external tech g, or content delivery workflows * Hands\-on experience with software development, scripting, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud services, or workflow automation * Experience working with MAM systems, workflow orchestration platforms, media processing systems, or enterprise content platforms * Proven ability to lead technical teams through complex system integrations and production\-critical delivery efforts * Strong troubleshooting skills across media workflows, system integrations, metadata exchange, and operational support issues * Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, production stakeholders, vendors, and executive leadership **Preferred Experience** * SDVI Rally or comparable media workflow orchestration platforms * MAM, DAM, CMS, or media asset lifecycle systems * Transcoding, automated QC, mastering, localization, packaging, and delivery workflows * IMF, ProRes, mezzanine formats, proxies, captions/subtitles, audio deliverables, metadata, and distribution packages * API\-based integrations, message queues, event\-driven workflows, cloud storage, and media pipeline automation * AWS, cloud media services, serverless workflows, or scalable cloud\-based processing environments * Modern web based application technologies (react, nest, node, tailwind, prisma, typebox, etc) * Vendor integrations and external partner workflows * Internal enterprise platforms rather than consumer\-facing applications * Experience supporting high\-volume, deadline\-driven media operations * Industry\-recognized credentials or training in cloud architecture, software engineering, Agile, project delivery, media systems, or management practices **How We Get Things Done…** This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview. **Championing Inclusion at WBD** Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law. If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request. In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $123,200\.00 \- $228,800\.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short\- and long\-term incentives, and program\-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation. If you’re a qualified candidate with an arrest or conviction record, please know that your application will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

This role works closely with the systems and architecture that power our business — from the CMS and editorial tools that enable journalists to create and publish stories, to the platforms that deliver content across our website, app, and linear channels. In this role, you will partner with senior leadership — especially the SVP of Product, Platforms — as well as cross\-functional partners across Product, Design, Technology, Video Production, and Editorial, to help make platform priorities real through disciplined execution, structured operating practices, and clear communication. This role does not have direct reports, requiring someone who is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to drive work forward. You will also collaborate with operational peers, as well as Technical Program Managers, ensuring alignment across functions and helping teams adopt a cohesive operating model across the broader organization. A core focus of this role is operationalizing platform changes, building and improving the processes that turn priorities into shipped work, supporting experimentation and performance practices across teams, and ensuring stakeholders — from editorial and newsroom partners to product and engineering teams — have the systems, tools, and workflows they need to deliver exceptional content experiences at scale. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, is highly organized, understands platform and product development workflows, and can work and collaborate credibly with technical teams while keeping practical execution front and center. Prioritization** * Design and manage a structured intake process for platform\-related requests, including CMS enhancements, editorial tooling, workflow automation, platform support, experimentation needs, and technical dependencies * Partner with Platforms leadership and technical teams to assess requests, clarify requirements, identify risks, and help sequence work across BAU operations and priority initiatives * Refine processes to balance flexibility with clarity, speed, and execution discipline **Operational Excellence \& Ways of Working** * Establish and run core team rituals, ceremonies, and planning processes for the Platforms organization * Drive consistency in how work is tracked, managed, and communicated through tools such as Jira and Confluence * Identify and implement ways to streamline technical workflows, reduce friction, and improve team velocity across editorial, product, and engineering partners * Operationalize AI\-powered tools and methodologies, ensuring teams have the right support, training, and governance to adopt responsibly **Planning, Alignment \& Execution Support** * Support planning cycles by turning priorities into clear workstreams, milestones, and follow\-up actions * Partner closely with Platforms leadership to keep teams aligned on goals, dependencies, and commitments, ensuring decisions are translated into practical execution plans that are technically feasible * Connect platform roadmaps, editorial needs, and product priorities by helping teams manage dependencies, unblock decisions, and deliver successfully **Experimentation \ orm dependencies — must have the ability to facilitate technical conversations, triage platform requests, and assess complexity and risk + Experience with CMS testing infrastructure + Comfort reading and interpreting data in SQL or BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode to support platform performance and experimentation reporting * Strong understanding of platform and product development workflows, including CMS, editorial tooling, content publishing, experimentation, and performance optimization * Experience supporting or working within a Platforms, Product, or Engineering organization in a media, publishing, or content\-driven environment * Proven ability to design, implement, and maintain scalable processes in a complex, matrixed environment * Experience with experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, and A/B testing methodologies * Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Airtable, Figma, and platform monitoring jobs.title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer - Solace
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Infrastructure Engineer–Solace to join the Solace Engineering team. We design and engineer low‑latency Solace platform made up of Solace PubSub\+ Event Brokers (Hardware Appliances) that support our most critical applications. The ideal candidate is a hands‑on Solace infrastructure engineer with a forward‑looking mindset centered around the 3As: Automation, APIs, and AI. You are a strong advocate of DevOps, SRE, and Agile practices and play a key role in designing and building a standardized, scalable, and resilient hardware‑based Solace platform. As a lead engineer, you will bring a strategic engineering mindset and deep experience managing complex enterprise infrastructure. In this role, you will collaborate closely with infrastructure teams and architects to design self‑service, highly available, and low‑maintenance platforms. You will also empower development and operations teams by building robust, value‑added tooling and automation through scripts and APIs. **In this role, you will:** * Lead complex initiatives to design, build, and engineer infrastructure solutions supporting mission‑critical business applications * Drive an automation‑first infrastructure engineering strategy, ensuring infrastructure is designed to be programmatically provisioned, configured, and managed * Apply AI‑assisted engineering capabilities to accelerate infrastructure development, including code generation, configuration validation, design analysis, and standardization * Participate in projects to modernize and evolve Solace infrastructure architecture, aligning with target‑state engineering principles * Evaluate internal and external technologies, including AI‑enabled engineering platforms, to support infrastructure build, automation, and architectural goals * Design infrastructure patterns and tooling that reduce manual effort and improv repeatability, reliability, and engineering quality * Design, build, deploy, and maintain infrastructure solutions through collaboration with engineering teams * Design, code, test, debug, and document infrastructure automation and tooling using Agile engineering practices * Make technical decisions related to architecture, automation frameworks, AI usage, implementation plans, and engineering tradeoffs * Identify engineering risks and dependencies early and define mitigation strategies through design and automation * Direct daily risk and control activities, ensuring infrastructure engineering aligns with policies, procedures, and standards * Recommend engineering approaches that improve cost efficiency, scalability, resiliency, and speed of delivery * Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, managers, customers, and vendors to resolve complex engineering challenges. **Required Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience * 3\+ years of middleware engineering or administration experience using Solace PubSub\+ hardware appliances and/or Solace PubSub\+ Software Brokers (OCP Containers and Public Cloud) * 5\+ years of experience building and managing enterprise‑scale infrastructure using automation * 3\+ years of advanced coding or scripting skills, with a strong focus on infrastructure automation (e.g., Python or similar). **Desired Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience with observability and monitoring tools such as RTView, Grafana, Prometheus, and BigPanda * 5\+ years of automation experience using Python, SEMP APIs, GitOps, and integration with CI/CD pipelines and internal developer platforms (IDPs) * Expert‑level knowledge of Splunk, including dashboard creation and alert configuration * Experience with scheduling tools such as Autosys or similar platforms * Ability to provide Level 3 (L3\) engineering support for operations and development teams * Familiarity with Tomcat, Java, and database technologies * Expert understanding of infrastructure engineering technologies, including Infrastructure as Code (IaC) * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and remediate complex technical engineering and support issues. **Job Expectations:** * This position offers a hybrid work schedule * This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship * Relocation assistance is not available for this position. **Pay Range** Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities. $119,000\.00 \- $224,000\.00**Benefits** Wells Fargo provides eligible employees with a comprehensive set of benefits, many of which are listed below. Visit Benefits \- Wells Fargo Jobs for an overview of the following benefit plans and programs offered to employees. * Health benefits * 401(k) Plan * Paid time off * Disability benefits * Life insurance, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance * Parental leave * Critical caregiving leave * Discounts and savings * Commuter benefits * Tuition reimbursement * Scholarships for dependent children * Adoption reimbursement **Posting End Date:** 13 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*** **We Value Equal Opportunity** Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements. **Applicants with Disabilities** To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo. **Drug and Alcohol Policy** Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more. **Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:** a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo. b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

Review and analyze complex multi\-faceted, larger scale, or longer\-term Specialty Software Engineering challenges that require in\-depth evaluation of multiple factors, including intangibles or unprecedented factors. Contribute to the resolution of complex and multi\-faceted situations requiring solid understanding of the function, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements that meet deliverables. Strategically collaborate and consult with client personnel. Required Qualifications: Specialty Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work or consulting experience, training, military experience, education. **Key Responsibilities:** Develop Agentic AI Solutions * Design, build, and enhance AI agents that automate marketing campaign activities. * Create multi\-agent workflows where AI agents collaborate to complete business tasks. * Implement Agentic AI orchestration patterns and decision\-making frameworks. * Support production AI agents and develop new agents as the platform scales from 6 to 20\+ agents. ### **Build Backend Services and Microservices** * Develop and maintain Python\-based backend applications. * Design scalable microservices architectures. * Build fault\-tolerant, highly available distributed systems. * Create event\-driven services that integrate with enterprise platforms. ### **API Development \& Integration** * Design and develop REST APIs. * Integrate AI agents with internal and external systems. * Build service\-to\-service communication layers. * Support API performance, reliability, and scalability. ### **Implement LLM\-Based Applications** * Integrate Large Language Models into business workflows. * Develop Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. * Build hybrid RAG and knowledge graph\-enhanced AI systems. * Implement prompt engineering and prompt orchestration strategies. * Configure tool calling and model routing capabilities. ### **Design Enterprise AI Workflows** * Architect scalable AI workflows. * Design agent orchestration frameworks. * Optimize AI systems for: + Cost + Accuracy + Latency + Reliability ### **AI Governance and Responsible AI** * Implement AI guardrails and controls. * Build hallucination detection mechanisms. * Apply PII redaction and data protection controls. * Maintain audit logging and model monitoring. * Support human\-in\-the\-loop validation processes. ### **Vector Database and Semantic Search Development** * Design and manage vector database architecture. * Build embedding pipelines. * Develop semantic retrieval systems. * Implement re\-ranking strategies to improve AI response quality. ### **Data Engineering Support** * Work with Kafka and streaming data pipelines. * Process large\-scale enterprise data for AI applications. * Support real\-time data ingestion and retrieval workflows. ### **Optimize System Performance** * Profile and tune Python applications. * Improve database and query performance. * Implement caching strategies. * Leverage AsyncIO and multiprocessing for scalability. * Monitor system reliability and production health. ### **Collaborate with Technical Teams** * Participate in daily standups. * Work closely with architects, engineers, and AI specialists. * Troubleshoot technical issues and blockers. * Contribute to solution design and technical decision\-making. * Provide production support for deployed AI agents. **Key Requirements:** * Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. * Python: 5\+ years * Microservices: 5\+ years * applications. + Experience designing and consuming APIs. + Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, and AI orchestration concepts. + Experience working with MongoDB and jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About DealerOn** We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting\-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble. **Job Description** **Core Functions** * Serve as the embedded analytics partner to Product teams; define feature success * metrics before launch and measure outcomes after. * Design and execute platform experiments — page templates, form flows, * merchandising treatments, search experience — including power analysis and preregistered * success criteria. * Deliver clear reads on whether launches performed, including negative results. * Apply quasi\-experimental methods where controlled tests are not feasible: stagedrollout * cohorts, difference\-in\-differences, matched comparisons, holdouts. * Produce the analysis behind OEM and enterprise dealer group business reviews, * and present those findings in the meeting alongside Account Management and the * Director, who own the relationships. * Answer network\-level OEM questions: dealer base performance against benchmark, * lagging markets and their causes, digital program and co\-op spend effectiveness. * Build and validate predictive models: lead scoring, days\-to\-sell and inventory turn, * renewal risk, market\-level demand forecasting. * Partner with Data Engineering to move models and pipelines into production. * Build the cross\-network benchmarks used by OEM and enterprise account teams. * Partner with Marketing to produce original research for external publication — * industry studies, benchmark reports, whitepapers — owning the methodology, the * analysis and the accuracy of every figure. * Serve as the technical author behind that work as it reaches a wider audience: sales * enablement material, conference and webinar content, and press or analyst * enquiries. * Convert recurring analyses into dashboards, templates and documented pipelines. * Escalate platform issues surfaced in client data to Product, including where the cause is DealerOn's. **Requirements** * 3–5 years in analytics, data science, or analytics consulting. * Advanced SQL — complex analytical queries against a data warehouse, written and * debugged unaided. * Python or R, with pandas or dplyr and a statistical modelling library (statsmodels, * scikit\-learn, tidymodels). * Experimentation and causal inference: test design, power analysis, and quasiexperimental * methods where a clean test is unavailable. * Applied predictive modelling with evaluation against real baselines. * Experience embedded with product managers and engineers, working to their * cadence. * Experience presenting analysis directly to senior business stakeholders and * defending it under questioning. * BI tool fluency: Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar. * Effective use of AI coding assistants, with the judgment to verify their output. **Preferred** * SaaS, digital marketing, agency, or automotive retail experience. * Familiarity with OEM digital programs, co\-op, or tier\-3 marketing. * Marketing measurement depth: attribution, incrementality testing, media mix * modelling, GA4\. * Analytics engineering practice: dbt, warehouse modelling, orchestration. * Cloud warehouse experience: BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift. *Automotive experience is not required.* \#LI\-Remote **This position is open to US residents only.** **The targeted salary range for this position is $86,100 \- $128,700\.** The posted salary range for this position may be adjusted based on job\-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; internal pay equity; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions. **Perks and Benefits:** Aside from the awesome people you will get to interact with on a daily basis, we offer a number of benefits, including: * Medical, dental and vision insurance * Company matched 401K plan * Flexible PTO \+ Sick Leave * 6 weeks paid Parental Leave * 8 Paid National Holidays * Company\-paid basic Life Insurance * Voluntary supplemental Life Insurance * Voluntary long\-term/short\-term disability insurance * Voluntary Pet Insurance * Optional Healthcare/Dependent Care FSA Account DealerOn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We also participate in E\-Verify (for more information, click here: E\-Verify Participation and Right to Work). A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team. **The pay range for this role is:** 86,100 \- 128,700 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** At Avenue Z, we are a dynamic media and technology company with a powerful influence across all channels. Our leadership has been at the forefront of digital marketing and communications for over 30 years, pioneering innovative strategies that drive meaningful change in brand performance and business growth. When you join Avenue Z, you become part of a team that doesn’t just adapt to change but leads it, guiding some of the world’s most influential leaders and brands to new heights. We are driven by a deep passion for our craft and an unwavering commitment to integrity in everything we do. If you share our passion and values, explore our current job openings to see how you can make an impact with us.**The role** ------------ We are hiring a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to build and ship the agent systems that run social commerce for our brands and for our own platform. You will embed with the teams doing the work, performance media, creator and influencer, ecommerce, and analytics, find the process where throughput is lost or money is left on the table, and build a production agent that owns it. Then you move to the next one. Concretely, this is work like: agents that detect and re\-authorize expiring TikTok Shop affiliate codes and Meta partnership permissions before spend stalls, systems that reallocate ad budget toward top\-performing creators automatically, pipelines that launch new creator content across every platform daily without a human touching it, and reporting infrastructure that tells a brand what actually drove GMV. You own the problem end to end: discovery, architecture, build, deploy, evals, adoption, and what breaks at 2am. If your instinct on a messy problem is to open an editor rather than schedule a working session, this is your role.**What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with a business unit, diagnose where throughput or margin is lost, and ship a working agent against it inside the first few weeks. * Build production agent systems: tool use, planning loops, memory, retrieval, orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates where money or brand safety is on the line. * Integrate deeply against the commerce and ad platforms our revenue runs on: TikTok Shop and TikTok Ads, Meta and Instagram, Amazon, Shopify, Google, Snap, and affiliate and creator APIs. * Build data pipelines and analytics infrastructure that tie creator content, ad spend, and attributed GMV into one picture. * Build the evaluation harness alongside the agent. Nothing ships to production without a way to measure whether it is right. * Own the infrastructure: APIs, queues, auth and token refresh, observability, error handling, rate limits, and cost controls. * Instrument everything. Every system you ship gets tied to a number: hours returned, cycle time cut, spend efficiency, GMV or revenue supported. * Document it, drive adoption with the team that uses it, and keep improving it after launch. **Who you are** --------------- * Computer science or another technical background, or equivalent hands\-on experience as a developer or as a self\-taught AI\-native builder. We care about what you have shipped and whether it works, not where you learned it. * 3 to 5 years building and shipping software that other people depended on. * You can read, write, and debug Python or TypeScript. You have deployed and maintained real services and you understand what is happening underneath, whether you wrote every line yourself or built it alongside AI coding tools. * Hands\-on experience building LLM agent systems: function and tool calling, RAG, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, agent evals. * Real experience integrating third\-party marketing, ad, or commerce APIs. You know what OAuth token expiry, rate limiting, webhook replay, and undocumented API behavior actually cost you. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), containers, CI/CD, and SQL. * You work fluently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. We expect you to build with them. We also expect you to be able to explain, debug, and defend what comes out of them. * You understand how performance marketing works: ROAS, CAC, attribution, creative testing, funnel mechanics, affiliate and creator economics. Or you can learn a domain fast and go deep, and you can prove it. * Entrepreneurial. You have built something of your own, a startup, a product, a side venture, an open source project, and can point to what you shipped and what it did. * High agency. You gather your own requirements, make the call, and ship. You do not wait for a spec, a committee, or a change management plan. * Able to sit with a senior executive or a brand's head of ecommerce, understand the business problem in their language, and translate it into a system without a translator in the room. **Nice to have:** direct experience with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, or Amazon Seller/Ads APIs. Background at a DTC brand, an ecommerce platform, a creator or affiliate network, or a performance agency. Prior forward deployed, applied AI, or founding engineer experience. **Benefits*** Competitive salary range: $90,000 \- $100,000 USD * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. * 401(k) plan with employer match. * Unlimited paid time off policy to support work\-life balance. * Professional development opportunities and budget. Please note that we do not offer Visa support of any type, and that the position is on\-site in Miami 4\-5 days per week.
