jobs.title: Automation Engineer – AGV Systems
jobs.description: **You may not know our name, but you know our products. What we make is part the places where we live, work and play – all day, everyday.** Zekelman is a family of companies — 100% domestic manufacturers — with a legacy dating back to 1877\. We’re proud to be the largest independent steel pipe and tube manufacturer in North America and the leading innovator in multi\-family housing development. **We believe in what we build and what we build, builds the world around us. Hospitals, hotels, schools, bridges, airports and more.** **Come build a career you believe in.** **Job Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled **Automation Engineer (AGV Specialist)** to take ownership of the programming, commissioning, and optimization of our newly installed Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) system. Operating across both our indoor bays, outdoor storage yards and building to building our heavy\-duty AGV system transports steel loads and other items in a demanding, high\-heat, and dynamic environment. In this role, you will write, modify, and troubleshoot the logic that controls vehicle navigation, traffic management, facility integration (automated doors, cranes, and conveyors), and safety zones. You will bridge the gap between physical machinery and software systems to ensure 24/7 operational reliability and maximum throughput. **Key Responsibilities** * **AGV Logic \& Fleet Programming:** Program, configure, and optimize AGV routing, traffic control, and dispatch sequencing using the AGV manufacturer’s proprietary fleet management software and scripting tools. * **PLC \& HMI Development:** Write and modify PLC code (e.g., Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, or Beckhoff) and HMI screens to integrate the AGV system with existing mill infrastructure like automated bay doors, charging stations, and material conveyors. * **Sensor \& Navigation Tuning:** Calibrate and troubleshoot hybrid navigation systems, including indoor LiDAR SLAM mapping and outdoor GPS/RTK or magnetic tracking systems. * **Safety System Configuration:** Program and test safety\-rated laser scanners, bumper zones, and emergency stop circuits to comply with industrial safety standards (ISO 3691\-4 / ANSI B56\.5\) across changing indoor/outdoor conditions. * **Systems Integration:** Partner with the IT and Operations teams to connect the AGV fleet management software to upper\-level manufacturing systems (MES, WMS, or ERP) via industrial protocols. * **Testing \& Commissioning:** Conduct field\-testing, path validation, and load\-testing of the vehicles under various weather conditions (rain, heat, snow) and surface transitions. * **Documentation \& Training:** Create detailed technical documentation, recovery procedures, and standard operating instructions; provide training to maintenance technicians and floor operators. **Required Qualifications** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related technical field (equivalent hands\-on industrial experience evaluated). * **Experience:** 3\+ years of experience programming and commissioning autonomous systems, AGVs, AMRs, or heavy industrial robotic workcells. * **PLC Expertise:** Strong proficiency in programming PLCs using languages like Ladder Logic, Structured Text, or Function Block Diagrams. * **Industrial Networking:** Solid understanding of industrial communication protocols such as EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus, or CAN bus. * **Navigation Systems:** Familiarity with AGV guidance technologies (LiDAR SLAM, laser triangulation, RTK\-GPS, or magnetic guidance). * **Environment:** Ability and willingness to work in a heavy industrial manufacturing environment, including exposure to heat, dust, outdoor weather conditions, and uneven terrain. **Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have) Skills** * Direct experience with heavy\-duty or high\-capacity AGV fleets (20\+ ton payloads). * Experience with scripting languages like Python, C\+\+, or SQL for database integration. * Prior experience working in the steel, automotive, or heavy mining sectors. We manufacture superior quality tubular and related products, and provide outstanding service for our valued customers. We seek to continuously advance the skills and opportunities of our employees, utilizing the latest technology and management tools available to consistently increase profitability and the enterprise value of Zekelman Industries and of our customers.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Insights
jobs.description: **Full time position open to fully remote work** **About b.well Connected Health** Healthcare is broken by fragmentation. Patients juggle dozens of disconnected portals, carry clipboards full of forms, and struggle to make sense of their own health data. b.well Connected Health exists to fix that. We are a healthcare technology company on a mission to transform healthcare into a simple, on\-demand experience, one where consumers are truly at the center. Our platform unifies fragmented health data from hundreds of sources (clinical, claims, device, wearables, etc.) into a single AI\-ready longitudinal health record, powering connected digital health experiences for health plans, providers, employers, and the world's leading technology companies. Our partnerships with OpenAI, Samsung, Google, and Perplexity, and our commitment to the CMS\-Aligned Network, reflect our position at the forefront of healthcare interoperability. Products like bailey™, our white\-label AI health assistant, and the b.well Health AI SDK are redefining what's possible when great data meets great design. If you believe that patients should access their health records as easily as they board a plane, and that design can genuinely change healthcare, this is your role. **About the Role** b.well's Clinical Data Platform ingests, evaluates, and acts on clinical data at scale — pulling FHIR resources from national and regional data sources, evaluating them against quality measures (HEDIS/NCQA) using a CQL execution engine, and turning the results into tasks, notifications, and care recommendations that reach real patients through our Health Programs applications. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to operate at the seams of this system: the shared libraries a dozen\-plus services depend on, the production incidents that cross service boundaries, and the architectural calls that determine whether the next six months of feature work is easy or painful. This is a senior individual\-contributor role — deeper and broader in scope than a Senior Engineer, focused on multiplying the effectiveness of the teams around you rather than accumulating direct reports. **What You'll Work On** * A distributed system of 15\+ Java microservices (Spring Boot 3\.5, Java 21, Gradle with dependency locking) spanning FHIR resource management, CQL\-based quality measure evaluation, task orchestration, and patient notifications — communicating primarily via Kafka with CloudEvents envelopes. * A shared internal FHIR client library, built on HAPI FHIR R4, consumed by nearly every Java service in the org. Changes here ship carefully — versioned releases, staged consumer rollout, and verification — because a mistake doesn't stay contained to one team. * A multi\-stage clinical data quality pipeline that assembles a member's clinical history and evaluates it against CQL\-based quality measures (e.g., breast cancer screening, colorectal screening) on a rolling 12\-month window, at population scale. * Mixed persistence and messaging: MongoDB (CQL result caching, notification preferences), PostgreSQL with Flyway (measure orchestration state), Kafka (including MSK IAM\-authenticated CDC streams), Redis/Caffeine caching, and S3\-backed bundling. * Production\-grade distributed systems problems: consumer group rebalance storms, cursor pagination bugs that silently drop records at scale, ID\-form mismatches between systems that only surface for a subset of members, OOM loops under specific data shapes. You'll be the person other engineers loop in when a bug doesn't have an obvious owner. * Federated GraphQL and REST APIs (Netflix DGS) fronting the FHIR\-based data model, plus event\-driven integrations with Iterable for patient messaging. * Deployment and observability on AWS/EKS — Helm\-based Kubernetes deployments, OpenTelemetry export to Groundcover, and CI/CD via shared GitHub Actions workflows with automated security patching (root.io/Aikido) and Karate\-based end\-to\-end test gates. **What You'll Do** * **Root\-cause the incidents nobody else can close.** Trace symptoms across Kafka consumers, FHIR persistence, and downstream services to the actual root cause — not the nearest workaround — using hypothesis\-driven investigation, then land the fix with tests that prove it. * **Own cross\-cutting technical initiatives end\-to\-end.** Things like a persistence migration for a core platform service, a CVE remediation sweep across a dozen\+ repositories, or a schema alignment that requires coordinated, ordered PRs across multiple services — you scope it, sequence it, and see it through. * **Set technical direction for a slice of the platform,** in collaboration with — not isolation from — the engineers building on top of it. Write the design docs and ADRs; get them reviewed; make the call when reasonable people disagree. * **Raise the bar on code review and engineering standards** across multiple repositories, not just your own team's. Contribute to shared conventions (hexagonal architecture guidelines, coding standards) that other services adopt. * **Be a force multiplier for other engineers.** Unblock people stuck on distributed systems problems, review architecture before it's implemented rather than after, and turn one\-off investigations into reusable tooling or documentation so the next engineer doesn't start from zero. * **Balance urgency against correctness under production pressure.** Distinguish a symptom fix that needs to ship now from the root cause that needs to ship next, and be honest about which one you're doing. **What We're Looking For** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Kafka, Spring Data). * Proven experience owning distributed systems in production — Kafka or an equivalent event streaming platform, and the operational maturity that comes with having debugged consumer lag, rebalancing, and message\-ordering issues firsthand. * Experience maintaining a library or service with many internal consumers, and the discipline that requires around versioning, backward compatibility, and staged rollout. * Comfort reading and reasoning about healthcare data standards — FHIR (HL7 R4\) or similar structured interoperability standards. CQL, HEDIS/NCQA quality measures, or clinical data experience is a strong plus, not a requirement. * A track record of driving technical initiatives that span multiple services or teams, from design through delivery, without needing a program manager to hold the plan together. * Experience with at least one of PostgreSQL or MongoDB in production, plus AWS (EKS/Kubernetes, S3, IAM) or equivalent cloud infrastructure. * Strong written communication — you'll be writing design docs and ADRs that other engineers implement against, and PR reviews that teach as much as they gatekeep. * A bias toward finding root causes over shipping the fastest patch, tempered by good judgment about when "fastest patch now, root cause next" is the right call. **Compensation** The target salary range for this position is $185,000 – $250,000, and is part of a competitive total rewards package including stock options, benefits, and incentive pay for eligible roles. jobs.title: Product Designer, Patient Experience
jobs.description: **Product Designer, Patient Experience** **About Us** At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer\-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Product Designer, Patient Experience to own design end\-to\-end for Gifthealth's patient\-facing surfaces. This position plays a key role in supporting the UX \& Designdepartment and reports to the Senior Director of Digital Experience, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards. You'll sit with the PMs and engineers who own the portal, checkout, enrollment, and patient communications, and you'll own the design work for those surfaces: flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity UI, prototypes, and the handoff that makes them real. This is a hands\-on craft role: most weeks are spent designing, testing, and shipping, not writing strategy docs, but you're expected to push on whether a problem is the right one, get in front of patients to find out, and come back with options rather than one answer you've already fallen in love with. This is an individual\-contributor Product Designer role (2\-5 years), not a senior seat. You'll have a design lead and a senior designer close by to calibrate the harder calls, and the expectation is that you can take a problem, frame it, design it, and hand it off cleanly without being managed through it. **Key Responsibilities** * **Surface ownership:** Design for the Patient Experience surfaces: portal, checkout, enrollment, insurance and access flows, and patient communications. * **End\-to\-end design:** Own end\-to\-end design on the work assigned to you: problem framing, flows and IA, wireframes, high\-fidelity UI, and every state (empty, loading, error, success, edge cases). * **Evidence for your decisions:** Run lightweight usability tests, watch session recordings, and partner with Research on the bigger questions. Show why the design is the way it is. * **Prototypes that answer questions:** Build fast, get them in front of patients or internal proxies, and change your mind when the evidence says to. * **Clean handoff:** Give engineering work that is ready to build: specs, states, responsive behavior, accessibility annotations. Review the build and hold the fidelity bar. * **Accessible by default:** Treat WCAG AA as the floor. Real inclusivity for elderly and low\-tech\-literacy patients is the goal. * **Design system citizenship:** Use the design system with judgment, don't fork it, and surface gaps to the system owner instead of working around them. * **Critique participation:** Bring your own work to review early and give useful feedback on others' work. **Qualifications** * **Education**: No specific degree required; equivalent practical experience will be considered. * **Experience**: 2\-5 years designing digital product, with a portfolio of shipped work: real product, real constraints, real users, not concept pieces or agency comps. * **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**: + Case studies that show the whole process: what the problem was, what you tried, what the evidence said, what shipped, and what happened after. + Solid interaction and visual craft. Clean, usable, consistent. You handle edge cases and responsive behavior without being reminded. + End\-to\-end thinking. You design flows, not screens, and you know where the patient came from and where they go next. + Comfortable running your own lightweight usability testing. + Strong Figma fundamentals: auto\-layout, components, variables, working inside an existing system. + Clean engineering handoff and a track record of engineers trusting your files. + Hands\-on with AI tools in your actual workflow, not just curious about them. + Self\-directed. You take an ambiguous ask, figure out what “done” looks like, and drive it there. + Preferred: Healthcare, healthtech, pharmacy, or another regulated environment. + Preferred: Consumer\-facing flows where conversion or retention was the goal. + Preferred: Experience designing for internal or operational tools alongside consumer surfaces. + Preferred: Contribution to a design system, even a small one. + Preferred: Motion or prototyping depth (Figma prototyping, Framer, code prototypes). + Not required: Managing designers, defining org\-level design strategy, or owning the design system. Those sit with the design lead and the senior designer. **Work Environment** * **Location**: Hybrid / Remote * **Schedule**: Full\-time * May require occasional flexibility to review builds or coordinate with engineering across release cycles. * Regular meetings with your PM and engineering partners, the design lead, and Research to ensure alignment. **Key Essential Functions** * Must be able to sit or stand at a workstation and use design tools (e.g., Figma) for extended periods. * Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, with PMs, engineers, Research, and design leadership. * Must be able to run and participate in usability testing sessions, including engaging directly with patients or internal proxies. * Must be able to work collaboratively across time zones with distributed Product, Engineering, and Design partners. **Employment Classification** **Status:** Full\-time **FLSA:** Exempt **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement** Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply! **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Strategic Deployments
jobs.description: monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000\+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership\-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition. As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organization, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, embedding deeply with C\-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build. This is part of a growing motion and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments. Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest\-value customers. You will advise executives on AI\-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes. You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP\-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption. This is an autonomous, high\-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward deployed engineering at monday.com. Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Atlanta office. **About The Role** * **Strategic transformation.** Embed with C\-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end\-to\-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission\-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout. * **Outcome ownership.** Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there. * **Build and ship.** Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself. * **Eval\-driven product feedback.** Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim. * **Cross\-functional leadership.** Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion. **What we promise** This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome\-based success criteria agreed before the build starts. **Requirements** * 5\+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full\-stack depth * Experience leading hands\-on projects end to end in a production environment, preferably client\-facing * Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool\-use protocols, evals, and prompt\-to\-production workflows * Experience navigating C\-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments * Track record of turning one\-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks * Entrepreneurial, fast\-moving, and focused on long\-term impact over immediate fixes **What** **monday.com** **can offer you:** * Join a customer\-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate \- not just things we put on a wall * Work on a multi\-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide * Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success * Grow fast through a dedicated L\&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons \- the industry moves quick and so do we * A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more *Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available.* *monday.com* *is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* *For Atlanta\-based hires only: Compensation Range: $162,000\-$207,000 base salary, subject to standard withholding and applicable taxes. In addition to base salary, the role includes opportunity to receive and/or earn a discretionary bonus and/or equity based on Company’s plans and in accordance with Company’s policies. Compensation finally awarded to the candidate will be commensurate with the candidate’s skills and experience. Compensation ranges for candidates in locations outside of Atlanta may differ based on the cost of labor and such additional factors for such other locations.* \#LI\-Hybrid Compensation Range: $162K \- $207K

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nscale** Nscale is the GPU cloud built for AI. We run high\-performance, cost\-efficient infrastructure for AI\-native startups and global enterprises, from bare metal up through the platform services teams actually build on. Our culture runs on ownership, accountability, and speed. We move with urgency, we tell each other the truth, and everyone here stays close to the infrastructure that makes AI work. **The Role** This is a career\-level SRE role for someone who wants to own systems, not just watch them. You'll take real surface area: the automation and tooling other engineers depend on, and the reliability of production services running AI and GPU workloads at scale. You'll sit in the incident rotation, and you'll be expected to make the systems you touch quieter over time. **What You'll Do** * Build and own the automation and tooling that keeps the platform running; treat operational toil as a bug to be fixed, not a fact of life. * Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, and the dashboards that make service health obvious at a glance. * Take point during incidents; troubleshoot under pressure, drive root cause analysis, and run post\- incident reviews that actually change the system. * Investigate performance and reliability problems across Linux, networking, and distributed services, then fix them at the source. * Partner with Engineering, Networking, and Infrastructure teams to raise the reliability bar across the stack. * Improve availability, scalability, and efficiency through code, not manual effort. What You'll Bring * 3\-6 years in SRE, systems engineering, or software engineering, including time running production in a data center or cloud environment. * Strong programming skills (Python, Go, or similar) and a genuine bias toward automating the work away. * Solid command of Linux, networking fundamentals, and distributed systems. * A track record of troubleshooting live production issues and owning the fix through to the retro. * Fluency with monitoring and observability; metrics, logs, dashboards, and alerting. * Comfort in a fast\-moving environment where priorities shift and you fill gaps without waiting to be asked. **Nice to Have** * Experience with AI or GPU workloads, or high\-performance computing (HPC). * Familiarity with high\-performance networking (InfiniBand, RDMA). * Kubernetes, plus virtualized or bare\-metal environments. On\-Call and Pace A quick note on the shape of the job. This role sits close to production, so there is an on\-call rotation, and some weeks are busier than others. We share it fairly, and we treat every page as a signal worth acting on rather than just an interruption. The goal is to make the systems quieter over time, so each rotation asks less of the person carrying it. If you take ownership of what you run and like leaving it in better shape than you found it, you'll do well here. What We Offer * Competitive base plus equity, reviewed every 12 months. * Real scope early, and a progression plan built around the skills you want to sharpen. * Flexibility that treats you as an adult; we care that the work gets done, and we trust you to shape your day. **Salary Range** $130,000 \- $200,000 USD. Actual compensation varies with skill set, experience, and location, and the role may be eligible for bonus and equity. Equal Opportunities Statement At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ\+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio\-economic backgrounds. If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.*
